Despite her traditional upbringing, Yui Kimura raced scooters in her hometown of Hida where she earned the reputation of being able to do the impossible with very little. Her father did his best to steer her away from what he believed to be masculine pursuits, but her grandmother secretly shared her grandfather’s engineer manuals and notes on car and motorcycle engines. Yui read her grandfather’s manuals and learned fast. She was able to not only maintain her scooter, but she modified the engine so that she could compete with older boys on motor crosses. With her grandfathers ‘good luck hachimaki’ wrapped around her arm, she raced local boys who, unable to keep up with her, worked together to orchestrate her defeat. No luck for them. Yui outmaneuvered them at every turn and became a sensation to all her friends.  When it came time to apply for school, Yui gathered her courage and confessed her ambition to race motorcycles to her father. An altercation ensued and when Yui refused to apply for a proper education, her father felt a great shame and told her she was no longer welcome in their home. With a heavy heart, Yui left for Nagoya with the blessings and savings of her grandmother.

Nagoya was not what Yui expected. She could only find low grade clerical work or minor jobs as a hostess. With the last of the money her grandmother gave her, she purchased a racing bike and entered illegal street races where she won more money than she had ever seen. Rumors of her courage and quick reflexes spread like wildfire. Soon she had an unofficial retinue of women motorcyclists wearing Yui’s signature pink. Along with a gang following her, Yui realized she had a stalker following her in the shadows. When Yui realized her lucky handkerchief had been stolen from her apartment, she took her concerns to the police who laughed and dismissed her, saying her stalker was probably a nice guy and that she would probably marry him in the near future.

One evening Yui returned home to find the stalker in her apartment going through her things. He hadn’t seen her, and she wasn’t sure what she should do. But the sight of him going through her clothes was too much to bear. She yelled for him to leave.  The stalker turned to her with a knife. He lunged at her.  She evaded his attack, and he hit the wall and dropped his knife. Without hesitation, Yui tackled him. They rolled over the ground exchanging desperate blows. Yui took more blows than she had ever experienced racing scooters in Shirakawa. With a surge of adrenaline, she managed to overpower her stalker, snatching the knife from the floor and holding the razor-sharp blade to his neck.

When the police reached her apartment, they took him away and rushed Yui to the hospital for trauma. X-rays revealed she had broken her arm and foot in several places. It wasn’t long before her gang showed up one by one and together they helped her pay her medical bills.  Rehabilitation was difficult but Yui never gave up and with the support of her gang she was ready for the races. Yui’s first race after the attack her gang presented her with a new pink hachimaki with their signatures and good luck messages written all over it. Yui vowed she would help other women with her winnings and influence. True to her word, her gang became known as the Sakura 7 Gang and they wore pink hachimakis as a symbol of unity and support for women needing help from stalkers and abusers.

The Sakura 7 grew beyond the 7 members and Yui’s signature pink became synonymous with women’s empowerment. At street races women would line up in droves to support her. After winning seven straight races in a row, she attracted the attention of a sponsor. She not only earned a spot at the All-Japan Moto Championship but was the youngest woman to race and win in the prestigious event. Her sponsorship soon tripled. So, too, did her gang. But everything came to a staggering halt at the illegal TK3 (Tokyo Kick 3000) street races. Yui was leading the race until she entered an unnatural fog that seemed to have appeared from nowhere. Baffled and confused, she stopped her bike and dismounted. It wasn’t long before she realized she wasn’t in Tokyo anymore.

Growing up in a Lebanese household in Brooklyn, Zarina struggled with two unique cultural identities. She felt this cultural difference painted a target on her back. To avoid ridicule and bullies, she observed what popular kids liked and learned to project the image they preferred. At school, she would go by the name "Karina," dye her hair lighter, and trash her “foreign” lunches.

At home, the news channel was always on. Urgent reports of injustice captivated Zarina, inspiring her to produce her own stories. When she was a teenager, she embraced her real name and roots and borrowed her father’s digital camera to interview members of her community in Bay Ridge. By posting her content online, she slowly built a loyal following. Each week, she picked a new issue and challenged people to speak their mind on camera.

When she heard a rumor that a fast-food restaurant owner was exploiting workers, she decided to go undercover and produce a hard-hitting film. She modified her look, faked an accent, and secured a waitress position at the restaurant. After three weeks of unpaid work, she was fired for demanding her paycheck. To retaliate, she posted clips of the restaurant owner’s abusive behavior and within hours the news had picked up her story, but somehow spun it to create sympathy for the restaurant owner.

Embittered by the experience, Zarina committed to become an independent producer and filmmaker. Her first feature film was for a competition at school inspired by an English class poem about Sacco and Vanzetti, two Italian migrants controversially executed for murder. Her film won first prize and launched her as an uncompromising documentary filmmaker.

Months later, her world turned upside down. A public video surveillance camera filmed her father carrying two coffees at a street corner a few blocks from home. A tall, hooded man stood behind him. The man shouted something at her father who took a step back, startled. Suddenly and unexpectedly, the man pushed him in the street as a car sped by.

His death sent a shockwave of anger and pain that left Zarina in pieces.

The perpetrator—Clark Stevenson—was soon arrested and incarcerated for manslaughter.

Zarina became obsessed with Clark--his gang “IR-28”, his short prison sentence, his apparent lack of remorse. A year went by and she had uncovered enough about Clark to shed more light on his crime. With the last of her inheritance she bought a new camera and a plane ticket to Nebraska and bribed the warden at Hellshire Penitentiary to let her interview Clark.

She filmed their first meeting and asked him about her father and his gang and his violent tendencies. Clark refused to talk; but, in the weeks that followed, she used her research to push his buttons and finally got a confession of a pre-meditated crime.

Zarina’s film became a tribute to her father and the trail of blood left by gang violence. When the news finally picked up the story, it was because the film had gained international acclaim.

Some inmates contacted her when they heard about her documentary. Most of them shared eccentric anecdotes in hopes of being filmed, but one story stood out from the rest: an entire wing in Hellshire Penitentiary was sealed off because of the “Mad Mick Massacre.” The official story was an Irish outlaw had heartlessly slaughtered the warden and his guards.

From working on her Sacco and Vanzetti film, Zarina knew that the ‘official’ story wasn’t always the ‘true’ story. She investigated Hellshire’s records and found an Irish-American inmate sentenced to twenty years for assault in 1860. According to the penitentiary’s blueprint, the sealed off wing was part of Hellshire’s original infrastructure. If she reached that sealed off section, she could shed some light on the Mad Mick story. All she needed was a way in.

Next morning, she was joining the Hellshire Penitentiary walking tour. She blended in the crowd of jet-lagged tourists and veered off when they headed toward the kitchen. She’d memorized the blueprint and knew exactly where to go and how to avoid surveyance cameras. An unexpected security detail nearly cut her investigation short, but she was able to hide under an old, dusty prison bed. When the guards disappeared, she continued her search and finally found Mick’s cell.

Entering the dark, dilapidated cell, Zarina ran her hand across the old brick wall. Her fingers felt a marking and traced the letters: DEATH TO BAYSHORE. A loose brick fell, revealing a gap.

She inserted her hand. Fingers landed on a piece of cold, cracked metal. She fished it out… an old, rusty wrench. A damp chill ran down her spine and she looked down; a man lay at her feet, bleeding, his limbs contorted and his eyes, dark and terrified—her father’s eyes. A pool of crimson blood on black pavement. Paralyzed, black fog filled the cell and she shut her eyes to push these nightmarish visions out of her mind.

88D51C584B65143FE8992FB4796EEFE7:
It is impossible to describe the horrifying scenes I have witnessed… death and misery, in every shape of terror, rule this place.

I can no longer recall how I have come to this place. All I remember is the opaque, milky fumes of opium in the murky den hazing a sweet, welcoming abyss.

I awoke to dreadful screams in this endless night, at the feet an old tree that leaked foul-smelling fluids. I know not how to reach those poor souls, nor do I want to. Keeping a record is all I can do to make sense of it.
1B9C21954A8C4FB9BFD0E8A3D7081B2A: I discovered a hidden laboratory while running away from a monster. Its stocks are uncommonly plentiful. I observed shelves of alkaloids, crates of silver syringes, piles of protective clothes and a journal signed “Vigo.” Its pages are filled with notes on an ancient force that controls the nature of this place—that shapes it. I also noted a few drawings of the growing cankers I’ve seen on trees.
0061A86E4CF8BCA5796230A36EC3868F:
I have been obsessively deciphering Vigo’s journal. His work is elegant but erratic, drawing obscure conclusions from disjointed fields.

Most entries mention a powerful force, The Entity, which undergoes a purge that occurs once a year. During this period, The Entity is infested with blight. According to Vigo, cankers bloom into “Pustulas,” a type of flower that spurts putrid nectar—the thick fluid I saw oozing from the trees. The last pages of the journal mention a serum distilled from the nectar, but the pages detailing its effects and preparation were torn out.
B6868E554FC5C3748DBB8CB57206EFAA:
I’m hiding in a dense strip of forest. I’m desperate to erase the distressful images engraved in my mind. Last night, a disfigured man barged into the laboratory with a gruesome, mechanical mouth and shred the walls into splinters. I barely escaped with my life—and wounded my arm in the process.

I have no options left; these monsters find me no matter where I go. All I have is a journal filled with obscure promises of escape.

I will return to the laboratory.
8286D7774F800DD08BF762BCDF7AF866:
I’m close to death, I can feel it.

When I returned to the laboratory, I started experimenting with the putrid nectar and distilled it into a foul serum. But I made a terrible mistake. I injected the serum into a dead rodent, whose pupils dilated, and its body shook. I tried to restrain it, but the creature bit into my arm, ripping my wound open.

I stopped the bleeding, but I fear the damage is done.
180CCB43455FCAF1BEE9DD93A3EC8A25:
I awoke to a terrible cry booming from the cellar and a violent bout of nausea. Through the vile ordeal, I started to recollect what had happened.

Tainted with the foul serum, my wound had swollen with lymph, at which point my assailant returned. Most of our fight was a blur, but I can recall red tears trickling down his gruesome cheeks as I clawed at his face. And some moment later when I kicked him, sending him crashing into a brick wall. The power I felt then… there are no words for it. I now know that there is truth to Vigo’s methods.

Another cry. My assailant, now chained in the cellar, must be getting restless.

This is just the beginning.
30D61E7243B007447F8B73AA172FC32B:
I should have foreseen his escape, given the potent dosage I administered him, but I needed to see results.

Pustula flowers are now blooming on the path leading to the laboratory. According to Vigo’s journal, this rapid spread is a sign that the blight is at its peak.

Soon, there will be no more putrid nectar to extract.
15FC174B4798BAFCB7170ABA822CC772:
I slept very little. The acute throbbing in my wound sent me on a restless, agitated drowse. I have no strength left to be patient, and my distress fosters brutal methods.

There are no lines I will not cross.
E2B5E83B4834DF0A67BBA889DC9F9695:
I limited my rest to only a few minutes here and there--I cannot afford wasting time. Pustulas, once lush with nectar, were withering away at the roots of cankerous trees. I could only extract droplets from a few frail flowers.

I’m running out of time.
CC2EC17B44BEFEE2402D77860C608B57:
Based on Vigo’s calculations, tonight is my last chance.

I filled a syringe with the last drops of serum and injected it into my arm.
5233454F40E4791D0F0A259979A81F7F:
I did everything right… and failed.

I am stuck in this infernal place with no serum and nowhere to hide.
AFA27834465FD6328D7C20966A530FEC:
I looked for Vigo. I shouted his name with no concern for the monsters lurking about. I need to find him… I picture the scene, etching a canvas of wild lines in my mind, focusing on the moon and I know--something is off.

I fed the dead rodent under my pillow.
43FCAE1E422E1519F60384BA8F5C7D2E:
Soon, very soon, I will be at peace.

The cold claws of death are drawing near.
7BD29F974D473B2330C3A495C5521438:
It’s here.
The Entity is here.
It has found me.

  • Auric Cells are not capped.

  • Iridescent Shards are not capped.

DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M24B_MENU_C2_C4_F28_02: I've heard a lot about you.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M24B_MENU_C2_C4_F28_03: Magic powers aren't working anymore, huh?
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M24B_MENU_C2_C4_M11_02: Let's get out of here, Harrington.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M24B_MENU_C2_C4_M11_03: At least we're here together, right, Harrington?
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M24B_MENU_C2_C4_M24_01: What've you been up to, butthead?
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M24B_MENU_C2_C4_M24_03: Henderson, you gotta get us outta here.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M24_MENU_C1_02: I've got a bad feeling about this.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M24_MENU_C1_03: Is this like a pocket dimension?
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M24_MENU_C1_04: We are in some serious shit.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M24_MENU_C1_14: Guess this is my base of operations…
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M24_MENU_C2_C4_F08B_01: None of this makes sense, Robin.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M24_MENU_C2_C4_F08B_03: I don't think it's Russians this time, Robin.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M24_MENU_C2_C4_F08_01: We got this figured out, Nancy.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M24_MENU_C2_C4_F28_01: Mike must be worried sick, El.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M24_MENU_C2_C4_F28_03: Think you could save us, El?
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M24_MENU_C2_C4_M11B_02: You went in the fog too, Jonathan?
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M24_MENU_C2_C4_M24B_02: Eddie the Banished, living up to his name.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_GAMEPLAY_IDLE_03: There must be something I can do.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_GAMEPLAY_IDLE_06: Why is this happening to me?
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_GAMEPLAY_IDLE_10: There must be a way out of here.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_GAMEPLAY_TRIAL_START_05: I have to get out of here.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_GAMEPLAY_TRIAL_START_08: I can handle this. There's no other choice.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_GAMEPLAY_TRIAL_START_11: Don't be afraid. None of this is real.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_GAMEPLAY_TRIAL_START_12: This nightmare will be over soon.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_MENU_C1_03: This couldn't possibly be a simulation.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_MENU_C1_05: I still feel like I'm falling.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_MENU_C1_07: I should be dead. What happened?
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_MENU_C1_09: This place seems to have rules of its own.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_MENU_C1_10: I need to formulate a strategy.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_MENU_C1_11: This can't be the end. It can't be.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_MENU_C1_13: This is fine. I'm only dreaming.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_MENU_C1_14: There has to be an explanation.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_MENU_C1_15: Please. Don't let this be real.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_MENU_C1_17: This is just a dream. And all dreams end eventually.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_MENU_C2_C4_F13_02: Ms. Lee. What are you doing here?
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M25_MENU_C2_C4_F13_03: How do we get out of here, Ms. Lee?
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M26_GAMEPLAY_HOOKED_B_03: You's need to get me now.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M26_GAMEPLAY_HOOKED_B_10: You want a piece of me? Huh?
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M26_GAMEPLAY_IDLE_07: The hell have I been thrown into?
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M26_GAMEPLAY_SAVED_05: Don't waste anymore time on me.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M26_GAMEPLAY_TRIAL_START_07: Gotta get to the bottom of this.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M26_GAMEPLAY_TRIAL_START_09: What the hell is out there?
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M26_MENU_C1_03: No. I've got to get back.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M26_MENU_C1_04: How am I gonna get out of this?
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M26_MENU_C1_06: I'm trapped in here with the rest of them.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M26_MENU_C1_07: But… I gotta get back home.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M26_MENU_C1_09: Gotta get out, before it's too late.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M26_MENU_C1_11: Derek. I knew you were right.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M26_MENU_C1_13: Better not see that cop around here.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M26_MENU_C1_14: How many people have been pulled in here?
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M26_MENU_C1_15: We've all gotta get out of here.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M26_MENU_C1_20: What the hell have I gotten myself into?
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M26_MENU_C2_C4_M02_02: Jake? I've been looking for you.
DBDAudioVoiceOver.DIALOG_SVR_M26_MENU_C2_C4_M02_03: Wait. Is your name Jake Park?

EffectCardDB.872C2AD2488100340221E1BABDE38603: Killer and Survivors gain 1 Invitation charge.
EffectCardDB.CardAddInvitation__cardDescription: Killer and Survivors gain 1 Invitation charge.
EffectCardDB.A61CDBD0490ACCCB651F98A38D43FB53:
All unopened chests become Anniversary Chests and glow in a festive blue and gold tint when within 8 meters. After 60 seconds, all Anniversary Chests open on their own in an explosion of festive confetti. When within the aura range of any Anniversary Chest as it happens:
  • Survivors scream and suffer 25% Hindered status effect for 4 seconds.
  • Killer is Stunned.


Opening an Anniversary Chest before the Tryk expires guarantees a random Anniversary item.

Hindered reduces survivor movement speed.
EffectCardDB.CardAnnivChest__cardDescription:
All unopened chests become Anniversary Chests and glow in a festive blue and gold tint when within 8 meters. After 60 seconds, all Anniversary Chests open on their own in an explosion of festive confetti. When within the aura range of any Anniversary Chest as it happens:
  • Survivors scream and suffer 25% Hindered status effect for 4 seconds.
  • Killer is Stunned.


Opening an Anniversary Chest before the Tryk expires guarantees a random Anniversary item.

Hindered reduces survivor movement speed.
EffectCardDB.6F968CDF4ACCF9626D654FA3CEF29324:
All Dull Totems become Anniversary Totems and glow in a festive blue and gold tint. Anniversary Totems grant Bloodpoints, 10% Haste for 4 seconds, and reveal your aura to the opposing role when successfully channeled. Interrupted interactions only provide Bloodpoints. An Anniversary Totem becomes a Dull Totem after their gift has been granted.

Haste increases Killer and Survivor movement speed.
EffectCardDB.CardAnnivTotem__cardDescription:
All Dull Totems become Anniversary Totems and glow in a festive blue and gold tint. Anniversary Totems grant Bloodpoints, 10% Haste for 4 seconds, and reveal your aura to the opposing role when successfully channeled. Interrupted interactions only provide Bloodpoints. An Anniversary Totem becomes a Dull Totem after their gift has been granted.

Haste increases Killer and Survivor movement speed.
EffectCardDB.A3BD6E19406783140A671795163B5042: Remove 1 Invitation charge from the Killer and Survivors.
EffectCardDB.CardRemInvitation__cardDescription: Remove 1 Invitation charge from the Killer and Survivors.
EffectCardDB.CardAuraReveal__cardDescription: Killer's and Survivors' auras are revealed to all for 8 seconds.
EffectCardDB.EECA0D2A42AAA05DAC10CEBAA93E72ED: Killer's and Survivors' auras are revealed to all for 8 seconds.
EffectCardDB.AA35C8DE4CD28AAA897B97A228F4B94D:
Apply 20% Haste to the Killer and Survivors for 30 seconds.

Haste increases Killer and Survivor movement speed.
EffectCardDB.CardHaste__cardDescription:
Apply 20% Haste to the Killer and Survivors for 30 seconds.

Haste increases Killer and Survivor movement speed.
EffectCardDB.9AE5182B41E21A151A6EA4888C8ED788:
All Survivors receive 1 health state or are mended if inflicted with Deep Wound, then are afflicted with the Exposed status effect for 30 seconds.

Deep Wound will put a Survivor in the dying state unless it is mended before the timer runs out.
Exposed Survivors are downed by basic attacks, even if uninjured.
EffectCardDB.CardHealedExposed__cardDescription:
All Survivors receive 1 health state or are mended if inflicted with Deep Wound, then are afflicted with the Exposed status effect for 30 seconds.

Deep Wound will put a Survivor in the dying state unless it is mended before the timer runs out.
Exposed Survivors are downed by basic attacks, even if uninjured.

EffectCardDB.CardUndetectable__cardDescription: Suppresses the Killer's Terror Radius and Survivors' Scratch Marks for 30 seconds.

KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_Blessed_DESC: The Survivor is currently benefiting from an active Boon Totem
KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_Blindness_DESC: Killers or Survivors with Blindness cannot see essential auras.
KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_Bloodlust_DESC: In chase, Bloodlust increases Killer movement speed progressively
KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_Cursed_DESC: The Survivor is currently being affected by an active Hex Totem.
KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_DeepWound_DESC: The Survivor is bleeding out and must mend or be mended to prevent going down.
KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_Elusive_DESC:
Elusive Survivors:
  • Auras are hidden.
  • Leave no Scratch Marks.
  • Leave no Pools of Blood.
  • Make no grunts of pain.
KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_Endurance_DESC: Survivors with Endurance cannot be downed when hit and gain Deep Wound instead.
KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_Exhausted_DESC: Exhausted Survivors cannot use perks that give Exhausted.
KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_Exposed_DESC: Exposed Survivors are downed by basic attacks, even if healthy.
KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_Haste_DESC: Killers or Survivors with Haste move faster.
KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_Hemorrhage_DESC:
Survivors with Hemorrhage:
  • While not being healed, lose healing progress.
  • Leave more Pools of Blood.
KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_Hindered_DESC: Killers or Survivors with Hindered move slower.
KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_Incapacitated_DESC: The Survivor cannot Repair Generators, Heal Survivors, use Items, Sabotage Hooks, or interact with Totems.
KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_KillerInstinct_DESC: The Killer sees the approximate location of Survivors, even inside lockers.
KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_Lullaby_DESC: Survivors hear an auditory warning nearby The Killer.
KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_Madness_DESC: Madness causes Survivors to scream, and may result in Hallucinations and more difficult Skill Checks.
KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_Oblivious_DESC: Oblivious Survivors cannot hear the Killer's Terror Radius.
KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_Reveal_DESC: Survivor's Aura is revealed to the Killer.
KeywordsNamespace.KEYWORDS_Undetectable_DESC:
Undetectable Killers:
  • Have no Terror Radius.
  • Have no Red Stain.
  • Survivors cannot see their Aura.

PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_AceInTheHole_FlavorText_DESC: “Everything that glitters isn’t gold. But gold isn't worth a damn in this place, so this should come in handy.” -Ace
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_AceInTheHole_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you loot an item from a Chest, it will have:
  • A Visceral or lower rarity add-on.
  • {Tunable.S07P03.ModifyChestItemSecondAddonChance%}% chance for an Uncommon or lower rarity add-on.


When you escape, you keep your add-ons.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Adrenaline_GameplayText_DESC:
When all Generators are completed, if you are downed or injured, heal instantly. Then, ignoring {Keyword.Exhausted}:
  • You gain {Tunable.S02P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S02P03.HasteDuration}s.
  • You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S02P03.ExhaustionDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Aftercare_FlavorText_DESC: “Oil work to honor my best buddies, the best musicians I know. Their album got me through dark times.” -Jeff, oil on canvas, 16x16
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Aftercare_GameplayText_DESC:
You and up to {Tunable.S15P02.MaxSurvivors} Survivors see each other's Auras whenever:
  • You unhook them, or they unhook you.
  • You finish healing them, or they finish healing you.


This effect lasts until you are hooked.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Agitation_FlavorText_DESC: "At some point, the excitement of hooking one of us becomes more important than the desire to kill us."
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Agitation_GameplayText_DESC:
While carrying a Survivor:
  • You gain {Tunable.K01P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.
  • Your Terror Radius is {Tunable.K01P03.TerrorRadiusIncreaseSize}m larger.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Alert_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever the Killer breaks a Pallet or Breakable Wall, or damages a Generator:
  • You hear a sound cue.
  • You see their Aura for {Tunable.S09P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_AnyMeansNecessary_FlavorText_DESC: “I’ll hit you with everything I’ve got. Then I’ll do it again.” -Yui Kimura
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_AnyMeansNecessary_GameplayText_DESC:
While next to a Dropped Pallet, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} for {Tunable.S20P02.ActionTimeRequired}s to reset it.

You see the Auras of Dropped Pallets.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Autodidact_FlavorText_DESC: “There’s no limit to what you can achieve, as long as you back it up with hard work.” -Adam Francis
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Autodidact_GameplayText_DESC:
You start the trial with {Tunable.S14P03.StartingTokens} Tokens, up to {Tunable.S14P03.MaxToken}, and your good basic healing Skill Checks give {Tunable.S14P03.InitialProgressionPenalty%}% less progress.

While healing another Survivor without a Med-Kit:
  • Whenever you hit a basic Skill Check, you earn {Tunable.S14P03.TokensPerSkillCheck} token.
  • Whenever you hit a basic Skill Check, for each Token, you gain {Tunable.S14P03.ProgressionBonusPerToken%}% more progress.
  • You cannot get great basic Skill Checks.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BBQAndChilli_FlavorText_DESC: "I just can't take no pleasure in killing. There's just some things you gotta do. Don't mean you have to like it." -Drayton Sawyer
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BBQAndChilli_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you hook a Survivor, for {Tunable.K09P02.AuraRevealDuration}s, you see the Auras of all Survivors who are at least {Tunable.K09P02.MinDistanceFromHook}m away from the hooked Survivor.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Babysitter_FlavorText_DESC: “I promised to keep you shitheads safe, and that’s exactly what I plan on doing.” -Steve Harrington
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Babysitter_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor:
  • They gain {Tunable.S18P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S18P01.HasteDuration}s.
  • They leave no Pools of Blood for {Tunable.S18P01.StealthDuration}s.
  • They leave no Scratch Marks for {Tunable.S18P01.StealthDuration}s.
  • You see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S18P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BalancedLanding_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you fall from at least {Tunable.S05P01.RequiredFallHeight}m:
  • You gain {Tunable.S05P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S05P01.HasteDuration}s.
  • You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S05P01.ExhaustionDuration}s.
  • Your stagger is {Tunable.S05P01.FallStaggerReduction%}% shorter.
  • Your Grunts from falling are {Tunable.S05P01.FallGruntReduction%}% quieter.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Bamboozle_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you vault a Window, it is blocked for Survivors for {Tunable.K12P01.WindowBlockDurations}s.

You basic-vault Windows {Tunable.K12P01.WindowVaultSpeed%}% faster.

Only 1 Window can be blocked at a time.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BeastOfPrey_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you gain Bloodlust, gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for {Tunable.K08P01.UndetectableDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BetterTogether_FlavorText_DESC: “Let’s burn that lab to the ground.” -Nancy Wheeler
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BetterTogether_GameplayText_DESC:
While you are repairing a Generator:
  • Other Survivors see that Generator's Aura.
  • Whenever the Killer downs a Survivor, you see the Auras of all Survivors for {Tunable.S19P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BitterMurmur_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you see the Auras of Survivors within {Tunable.KG_Bitter_Murmur.AuraRevealRange}m of it for {Tunable.KG_Bitter_Murmur.AuraRevealDuration}s.

When all Generators are completed, you see the Auras of all Survivors for {Tunable.KG_Bitter_Murmur.AuraRevealEndgameDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BloodEcho_FlavorText_DESC: “Attack an enemy with precision and their allies will feel it.” -Renjiro’s Doctrine 6:3
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BloodEcho_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, for {Tunable.K18P02.HemorrhageExhaustionDuration}s, all injured Survivors:
  • Gain {Keyword.Exhausted}.
  • Gain {Keyword.Hemorrhage}.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BloodHound_FlavorText_DESC: "Pebbles shimmering in the moonlight; my life drips down in a trail so easy to follow."
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BloodHound_GameplayText_DESC: Pools of Blood are brighter and last {Tunable.K02P02.ExtraTrackDuration}s longer.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BloodPact_GameplayText_DESC:
While you are not the Obsession:
  • While you or the Obsession are injured, you see each other's Auras.
  • Whenever you finish healing the Obsession, or they finish healing you, while within {Tunable.S22P02.RequiredDistance}m of each other, you both gain {Tunable.S22P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.


When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BloodWarden_FlavorText_DESC: “This is my world. And you can't ever leave.” -Freddy Krueger
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BloodWarden_GameplayText_DESC:
When an Exit Gate is opened, once per trial, when you hook a Survivor, both Exits are blocked for {Tunable.K10P03.GateBlockDuration}s.

You see the Auras of Survivors within Exit Thresholds.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BoilOver_FlavorText_DESC: “Buck and Wild/ Swing to be free/Your hands just can’t keep ahold of me.” -Kate Denson’s Boil Over
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BoilOver_GameplayText_DESC:
While carried by the Killer:
  • Whenever the Killer falls from at least {Tunable.S13P03.RequiredFallHeight}m, you gain {Tunable.S13P03.FallExtraWiggle%}% of your current wiggle progress.
  • Your wiggle is {Tunable.S13P03.WiggleIntensity%}% stronger.
  • Within {Tunable.S13P03.HookAuraBlockRange}m, the Killer cannot see Hook Auras.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Bond_FlavorText_DESC: "We have to work as a team, I need you to survive so that I can survive!" -Dwight
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Bond_GameplayText_DESC: Within {Tunable.S01P01.AuraRevealDistance}m, you see other Survivors' Auras.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BoonDestroyer_FlavorText_DESC: "Nothing is permanent here. Nothing except our endless perdition." -Unknown, Notebook
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BoonDestroyer_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you snuff a Boon Totem:
  • You see the Auras of all Survivors within its range for {Tunable.SG_Shattered_Hope.AuraRevealDuration}s.
  • It is destroyed.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BorrowedTime_FlavorText_DESC: "Probably stings like hell, but it ain't gonna kill ya. Up and at 'em soldier. Time to move!" -Bill Overbeck
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BorrowedTime_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor:
  • They retain their unhook {Keyword.Endurance} for {Tunable.S08P02.EnduranceExtraDuration}s longer.
  • They retain their unhook {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S08P02.HasteExtraDuration}s longer.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BotanyKnowledge_FlavorText_DESC: "Basic botany knowledge could save your life someday." -Claudette Morel
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Breakdown_FlavorText_DESC: “Named Belly of the Beast, this wood piece had a story to tell; it didn’t waste its second chance.” -Jeff (ink & oil wash on wood)
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Breakdown_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you are unhooked:
  • The Hook breaks, then is repaired after {Tunable.S15P01.HookRespawnTime}s.
  • You see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S15P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Breakout_FlavorText_DESC: “Come, we’re going to rip our way out of this.” -Yui Kimura
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Breakout_GameplayText_DESC:
Within {Tunable.S20P03.RequiredDistance}m of a carried Survivor:
  • You gain {Tunable.S20P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.
  • The carried Survivor wiggles {Tunable.S20P03.ExtraWiggle%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BrutalStrength_FlavorText_DESC: "It's more than muscles. A dark power motivates the beast."
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BrutalStrength_GameplayText_DESC: You basic-break Pallets and Breakable Walls, and damage Generators {Tunable.K01P02.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BuckleUp_FlavorText_DESC: “Ghost beaters never leave a man behind." -Ash Williams
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BuckleUp_GameplayText_DESC:
While healing a downed Survivor, you both see the Killer's Aura.

Whenever you finish healing a downed Survivor or fully recover:
  • The Survivor gains {Tunable.S17P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S17P02.HasteDuration}s.
  • The Survivor leaves no Scratch Marks for {Tunable.S17P02.HasteDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BuiltToLast_FlavorText_DESC: "Architecture is the soul of civilization.” -Felix Richter
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_BuiltToLast_GameplayText_DESC:
While holding a depleted item, after hiding in a Locker for {Tunable.S23P03.RequiredDuration}s, it is recharged to {Tunable.S23P03.InitialRefill%}%.

Each time you recharge an item this way, it recharges {Tunable.S23P03.RefillDiminishing%}% fewer Charges.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_CalmSpirit_GameplayText_DESC:
You do not scare Crows or scream.

You bless and cleanse Totems, and unlock Chests silently, but {Tunable.S04P02.ActionSpeedReduction%}% slower.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Camaraderie_FlavorText_DESC: "So, remember once you get in there… pretend like you don’t care. There you go, you’re learning my friend. You’re learning.” -Steve Harrington
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Camaraderie_GameplayText_DESC: While you are struggling on Hook, when another Survivor gets within {Tunable.S18P02.PauseDistance}m, the timer is paused for {Tunable.S18P02.PauseTimer}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_CorruptIntervention_FlavorText_DESC: “It shall be known across the land that the Gods curse the unfaithful.” (The Tablet of Adiris, 3.7.)
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_CorruptIntervention_GameplayText_DE: When the trial starts, the {Tunable.K15P01.GeneratorsBlocked} farthest Generators from you are blocked for {Tunable.K15P01.GeneratorBlockDuration}s, or until you down a Survivor.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Coulrophobia_GameplayText_DESC:
Survivors within your Terror Radius:
  • Heal {Tunable.K12P02.HealPenalty%}% slower.
  • While healing, basic Skill Checks spin {Tunable.K12P02.SkillCheckSpeedIncrease%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_CruelConfinement_FlavorText_DESC: “The specimen seems to be able to perform some kind of telekinesis that impacts the state of nearby objects, as if they existed in some other form within a dimension alternate to our own.” -Hawkins National Laboratory
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_CruelConfinement_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever a Generator is completed:
  • You see the Auras of all Windows for {Tunable.K17P02.BlockDuration}s.
  • All Windows are blocked for Survivors for {Tunable.K17P02.BlockDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Dancewithme_FlavorText_DESC: “Dance with me, there’s a storm comin’/Follow my boots, try to keep up/Dance with me, until sun up.” -Kate Denson's Dance With Me
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Dancewithme_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you fast-exit a Locker, medium-vault, or fast-vault, you leave no Scratch Marks for {Tunable.S13P01.Duration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.S13P01.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_DarkDevotion_FlavorText_DESC: “And terror shall take hold of a defiant non-believer, who shall falsely announce my arrival.” (The Tablet of Adiris, 48.9)
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_DarkDevotion_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever the Obsession takes damage, for {Tunable.K15P03.TerrorRadiusTransferDuration}s:
  • Your Terror Radius is set to {Tunable.K15P03.TerrorRadiusSize}m.
  • The Obsession has your Terror Radius.
  • You gain {Keyword.Undetectable}.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_DarkSense_FlavorText_DESC: "Slow down, don't rush and try not to worry so much! The best way to beat him is to know how he thinks." -Lost Tapes: Murf
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_DarkSense_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever a Generator is completed, when the Killer gets within {Tunable.SG_Dark_Sense.AuraRevealDistance}m of you, you see their Aura for {Tunable.SG_Dark_Sense.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_DeadHard_FlavorText_DESC: “I thought to myself, ‘Gonna ’ave some fun ‘ere lads, let’s get stuck in!’ It were a right dust up, I swear down!” -David King
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_DeadHard_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you are unhooked, while injured and running, use {Input.ActivatableButton1}:
  • You gain {Keyword.Endurance} for {Tunable.S10P02.EnduranceDuration}s.
  • You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S10P02.ExhaustedDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_DeadMansSwitch_FlavorText_DESC: "I've seen the look on a man's face when he realizes he's going to die." -Caleb Quinn
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_DeadMansSwitch_GameplayText_DESC: When you hook a Survivor, the first time a Survivor stops repairing a Generator, it is blocked for {Tunable.K19P02.GeneratorBlockDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K19P02.GeneratorBlockDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Deathbound_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever a Survivor finishes healing another, they scream. Then, until they take damage, while they are at least {Tunable.K20P03.MaximumDistance}m away from that Survivor:
  • They gain {Keyword.Oblivious}.
  • They see that Survivor's Aura.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_DecisiveStrike_FlavorText_DESC: "There is nothing to be scared of." -Laurie Strode
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_DecisiveStrike_GameplayText_DESC:
Until all Generators are completed, whenever you are unhooked, for the next {Tunable.S06P02.EffectDuration}s: when the Killer picks you up, once per trial, hit a Special Skill check:
  • Stun the Killer for {Tunable.S06P02.StunDuration}s.
  • Become the Obsession.


This is disabled by conspicuous actions. At the start of the trial, you are more likely to be the Obsession.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Deerstalker_GameplayText_DESC:
Every {Tunable.KG_Deerstalker.RevealTimeIntervals}s, the Survivor with the least time in chase sees your Aura for {Tunable.KG_Deerstalker.RevealDuration}s.

While a Survivor sees your Aura, you see their Aura.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_DejaVu_GameplayText_DESC: You see the Auras of the {Tunable.SG_Deja_Vu.GeneratorsShown} Generators closest to each other and repair them {Tunable.SG_Deja_Vu.RepairSpeed%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Deliverance_FlavorText_DESC: “I was raised by a strict man who taught me how to make the best of a bad situation.” -Adam Francis
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Deliverance_GameplayText_DESC: Once per trial, when you safely unhook another Survivor, you can unhook yourself. When you unhook yourself this way, you gain {Keyword.Broken} for {Tunable.S14P02.BrokenDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_DesperateMeasures_FlavorText_DESC: "When they come with a wrecking ball, build stronger walls.” -Felix Richter
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_DesperateMeasures_GameplayText_DESC:
For each injured, downed, or hooked Survivor:
  • You heal {Tunable.S23P02.ExtraActionSpeed%}% faster.
  • You unhook {Tunable.S23P02.ExtraActionSpeed%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_DetectivesHunch_FlavorText_DESC: "Are you able to tell us where you were last night?" -Detective David Tapp
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_DetectivesHunch_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever a Generator is completed, for {Tunable.S12P02.RevealDuration}s, within {Tunable.S12P02.RevealDistance}m of you:
  • You see the Auras of Chests.
  • You see the Auras of Generators.
  • You see the Auras of Totems.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Discordance_FlavorText_DESC: "Smartasses get killed. We always see to that." -The Legion
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Discordance_GameplayText_DESC:
Within {Tunable.K14P01.EffectRange}m of you, whenever a Generator is being repaired by at least 2 Survivors, you are alerted.

While that Generator is being repaired by at least 2 Survivors, you see its Aura. When it is no longer being repaired by at least 2 Survivors, this ends after {Tunable.K14P01.AuraLingerDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Distortion_FlavorText_DESC: “Exploration of Norse mythology: bravery can conceal your flaws, even at your most vulnerable.” -Jeff, pencil on toned paper
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Distortion_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, and after being chased for {Tunable.S15P03.RegainTokenDuration}s, you earn {Tunable.S15P03.TokensRegained} Token, up to {Tunable.S15P03.MaxTokens}.

While not downed, whenever the Killer attempts to see your Aura, spend {Tunable.S15P03.StartingTokenAmount} Token. Then, for the next {Tunable.S15P03.HiddenDuration}s:
  • The Killer cannot see your Aura.
  • You leave no Scratch Marks.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Diversion_FlavorText_DESC: “There’s what is easy and then there’s what is right. If you confuse the two, there’s no telling what you become.” -Adam Francis
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Diversion_GameplayText_DESC:
After hiding for {Tunable.S14P01.RequiredChargeTime}s within the Killer's Terror Radius, while crouched and idle, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to throw a pebble {Tunable.S14P01.ThrowDistance}m away:
  • The Killer is alerted.
  • The pebble leaves Scratch Marks.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_DragonsGrip_FlavorText_DESC: “Such potential in this compound... even the slightest trace causes unnatural effects.” -Journal of Talbot Grimes
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_DragonsGrip_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you damage a Generator, for the next {Tunable.K21P01.ActiveDuration}s, the first Survivor that repairs that Generator:
  • They scream, then you are alerted to their position for {Tunable.K21P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.
  • They gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K21P01.ExposedDuration}s.


Cooldown: {Tunable.K21P01.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_DyingLight_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you hook a Survivor that is not the Obsession, earn {Tunable.K06P02.TokensPerHook} token.

While the Obsession is alive, for each Token:
  • Other Survivors heal {Tunable.K06P02.ActionSpeedPenaltyPerToken%}% slower.
  • Other Survivors repair {Tunable.K06P02.ActionSpeedPenaltyPerToken%}% slower.
  • Other Survivors sabotage Hooks {Tunable.K06P02.ActionSpeedPenaltyPerToken%}% slower.


The Obsession:
  • Heals other Survivors {Tunable.K06P02.ObsessionActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.
  • Unhooks other Survivors {Tunable.K06P02.ObsessionActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Empathy_GameplayText_DESC: Within {Tunable.S03P01.AuraRevealDistance}m, you see the Auras of injured Survivors.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Enduring_GameplayText_DESC: While not carrying a Survivor, Pallet-stuns are {Tunable.K03P01.StunDurationReduction%}% shorter.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_FireUp_FlavorText_DESC: “Now why don't you just fucking die?” -Freddy Krueger
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_FireUp_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever a Generator is completed, earn {Tunable.K10P01.TokensPerGenerator} Token, up to {Tunable.K10P01.MaxTokens}.

For each Token:
  • You basic-break Pallets and Breakable Walls {Tunable.K10P01.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.
  • You damage Generators {Tunable.K10P01.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.
  • You pick-up and drop Survivors {Tunable.K10P01.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.
  • You basic-vault Windows {Tunable.K10P01.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Fixated_FlavorText_DESC: "I wanna finish what we started. I want to kill it." -Nancy Wheeler
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Fixated_GameplayText_DESC:
While walking, you gain {Tunable.S19P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.

You see your own Scratch Marks.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_FlipFlop_GameplayText_DESC: While downed, whenever the Killer picks you up, {Tunable.S17P01.RecoveryRatio%}% of your recovery progress is added to your wiggle progress, up to {Tunable.S17P01.MaxWiggle%}%.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_ForThePeople_FlavorText_DESC: "We can write our own story and decide how it really ends." -Zarina Kassir
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_ForThePeople_GameplayText_DESC:
While healthy and healing another Survivor without a Med-Kit, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to heal them instantly:
  • You take damage.
  • You gain {Keyword.Broken} for {Tunable.S21P03.BrokenDuration}s.
  • You become the Obsession.


When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_ForcedPenance_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever a Survivor takes a protection hit, they gain {Keyword.Broken} for {Tunable.K20P01.BrokenDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_FranklinsLoss_FlavorText_DESC: "Sally, I hear something. Stop! Stop!" - Franklin
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_FranklinsLoss_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack, they drop their item.

Within {Tunable.K09P03.ItemsRevealDistance}m, you see the Auras of dropped items.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_FurtiveChase_FlavorText_DESC: "You have no idea what I have planned for you. It’ll be in the news for weeks: I’ll make sure of it." -The Ghost Face
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_FurtiveChase_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you hook the Obsession:
  • You gain {Tunable.K16P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K16P03.UndetectableHasteDuration}s.
  • You gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for {Tunable.K16P03.UndetectableHasteDuration}s.


Whenever the Obsession is unhooked, the Survivor who unhooked them becomes the Obsession.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Gearhead_FlavorText_DESC: "Sometimes a man's best work is what puts him in the grave." -The prison warden
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Gearhead_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever a Survivor takes damage, for the next {Tunable.K19P01.EffectDuration}s, whenever a Survivor repairing a Generator hits a good basic Skill Check, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K19P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_GeneratorOvercharge_FlavorText_DESC: "It is a trap. But a trap one must step in…" -The Doctor
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_GeneratorOvercharge_GameplayText_DE:
Whenever you damage a Generator:
  • Its regression speed will go from {Tunable.K07P03.StartingRegressionSpeed%}% to {Tunable.K07P03.MaxRegressionSpeed%}% over the next {Tunable.K07P03.RegressionRampDuration}s.
  • The next Survivor who starts repairing it gets a special Skill Check. If they miss it, they lose {Tunable.K07P03.GenRegressionOnFail%}% more progress.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_HangmansTrick_FlavorText_DESC: "No excuses, no equivocations… No crying." -Amanda Young
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_HangmansTrick_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

While carrying a Survivor, you see the Auras of Survivors within {Tunable.K11P01.AuraRevealDistance}m of Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor starts sabotaging a Hook, you are alerted.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_HeadOn_FlavorText_DESC: “People are remembered for what they overcome. You run or you face your fears and remind the world who you are.” -Jane Romero
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_HeadOn_GameplayText_DESC: After hiding in a Locker for {Tunable.S16P03.HideRequiredDuration}s, fast-exit to stun the Killer for {Tunable.S16P03.LockerStunDuration}s if they are within {Tunable.S16P03.LockerStunRange}m, then gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S16P03.ExhaustedDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_HexBloodFavor_FlavorText_DESC: “It would be no leap of the imagination to suggest that the trials are a biological response of sorts.” -Journal of Talbot Grimes
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_HexBloodFavor_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you damage a Survivor, Upright Pallets within {Tunable.K21P03.EffectRadius}m of them are blocked for {Tunable.K21P03.BlockDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_HexDevourHope_FlavorText_DESC: “If you do nothing, you have their blood on your hands. If you save them, her hunger grows.“
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_HexDevourHope_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked while you are at least {Tunable.K05P03.DistanceFromHook}m away, earn {Tunable.K05P03.TokensPerUnhook} Token, up to {Tunable.K05P03.MaxTokens}:
  • 2 Tokens | {Tunable.K05P03.HasteDelayDuration}s after hooking a Survivor, gain {Tunable.K05P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K05P03.HasteDuration}s.
  • 3 Tokens | Survivors gain {Keyword.Exposed}.
  • 5 Tokens | You can Kill downed Survivors.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_HexHauntedGround_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, 2 Dull Totems ignite.

When either of those Hex Totems is blessed or cleansed:
  • All Survivors gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K13P02.ExposedDuration}s.
  • The other Totem is extinguished.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_HexHuntressLullaby_GameplayText_DES:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you hook a Survivor, earn {Tunable.K08P03.TokensPerHook} Token. For each Token, Basic Skill Check warnings appear later and good success zones are smaller.

While you have 5 Tokens, Basic Skill Check warnings don't appear.

Whenever a Survivor misses a basic Skill Check, they lose {Tunable.K08P03.RegressionBonus%}% more progress.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_HexRetribution_FlavorText_DESC: "Bloody fool, you pulled the trigger on yourself." -Caleb Quinn
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_HexRetribution_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever a Survivor starts blessing or cleansing a Totem, they gain {Keyword.Oblivious} for {Tunable.K19P03.ObliviousDuration}s.

Whenever a Hex Totem is blessed or cleansed, you see the Auras of all Survivors for {Tunable.K19P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_HexRuin_FlavorText_DESC: “A curse is upon you. It will be your ruin.”
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_HexRuin_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

While a Generator is not being repaired, it regresses at {Tunable.K05P02.RegressionSpeed%}% speed.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_HexTheThirdSeal_FlavorText_DESC: “She touched your skin, you bear the witch's mark!”
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_HexTheThirdSeal_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic or special-attack, they gain {Keyword.Blindness}.

This applies for up to {Tunable.K05P01.MaxAffectedSurvivors} Survivors.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_HexThrillOfTheHunt_GameplayText_DES:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

For each Dull and Hex Totem remaining, you have {Tunable.KG_Hex_Thrill_Of_The_Hunt.TokensPerTotem} Token.

For each Token, Survivors bless and cleanse totems {Tunable.KG_Hex_Thrill_Of_The_Hunt.ActionSpeedReductionPerToken%}% slower.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_HexUndying_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites.

When another Hex Totem is blessed or cleansed, it replaces this one and keeps any Tokens it had.

You see the Auras of Survivors within {Tunable.K21P02.AuraRevealDistance}m of Dull Totems.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Hope_FlavorText_DESC: "Buckle up, fuckos! Let's roll!" -Lost Tapes: Nikki
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Hope_GameplayText_DESC: When all Generators are completed, you gain {Tunable.SG_Hope.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_ImAllEars_FlavorText_DESC: “There is no need to worry. I’ve been preparing my whole life for this." -The Ghost Face
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_ImAllEars_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever a Survivor fast-enters or fast-exits a Locker, or medium or fast-vaults within {Tunable.K16P01.ActivationRange}m of you, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K16P01.AuraRevealDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K16P01.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_InTheDark_FlavorText_DESC: "Oh, that gun's no good. The old way… with a sledge! You see, that way's better. They die better that way." -Nubbins Sawyer
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_InTheDark_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever a Survivor drops a Pallet, for the next {Tunable.K09P01.TriggerTime}s, if they move {Tunable.K09P01.DistanceThreshold}m away from it, they gain {Tunable.K09P01.Hindered%}% {Keyword.Hindered} for {Tunable.K09P01.HinderedDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_InfectiousFright_FlavorText_DESC: “Horror overcomes the heart of infidels who cry at the feet of the fallen.” (Hymn of Praise, 11. 4)
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_InfectiousFright_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever a Survivor is downed, Survivors within your Terror Radius scream and you are alerted for {Tunable.K15P02.RevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_InnerStrength_FlavorText_DESC: “All this time I’ve been trying so hard to pretend like everything’s fine, but it’s not.” -Nancy Wheeler
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_InnerStrength_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you cleanse a Totem, while injured and not {Keyword.Broken}, after hiding in a Locker for {Tunable.S19P03.HideDuration}s, you become healthy instantly.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Insidious_GameplayText_DESC: After being idle for {Tunable.KG_Insidious.TimeToActivate}s, you gain {Keyword.Undetectable} until you act.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_IronGrasp_GameplayText_DESC:
While carrying a Survivor:
  • They wiggle {Tunable.KG_Iron_Grasp.WiggleTimeIncrease%}% slower.
  • Their wiggle is {Tunable.KG_Iron_Grasp.WiggleStrengthReduction%}% weaker.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_IronWill_GameplayText_DESC: While injured and not {Keyword.Exhausted}, your Grunts of Pain are {Tunable.S04P01.InjuredNoiseReduction%}% quieter.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Ironmaiden_FlavorText_DESC: “This is no place for cowards.” -The Legion
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Ironmaiden_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever a Survivor exits a Locker:
  • They gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K14P03.ExposedDuration}s.
  • They scream, then you are alerted to their location for {Tunable.K14P03.RevealDuration}s.


You open Lockers {Tunable.K14P03.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K22P01_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, {Tunable.K22P01.ExtraChestsSpawned} more Chests appear.

Whenever a Survivor picks-up an Item or starts unlocking a Chest within {Tunable.K22P01.RevealDistance}m of you, you are alerted.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K22P02_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you damage a Generator, up to {Tunable.K22P02.AffectedGenerators} other Generators start regressing. Survivors repairing them get a special Skill Check. Cooldown: {Tunable.K22P02.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K22P03_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you earn {Tunable.K22P03.TokensGainedPerGenerator} Tokens, up to {Tunable.K22P03.MaxTokens}.

Whenever you lunge-attack, spend {Tunable.K22P03.TokensSpentPerLunge} Token to make it {Tunable.K22P03.LungeExtraDuration%}% longer.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K23P01_FlavorText_DESC: "Enjoy this moment, few get so close." -Hak Ji-woon
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K23P01_GameplayText_DESC:
While carrying a Survivor, Survivors within your Terror Radius gain {Keyword.Exposed}. This ends {Tunable.K23P01.ExposedLingerDuration}s after:
  • They leave your Terror Radius.
  • You drop or Hook the carried Survivor.


Cooldown: {Tunable.K23P01.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K23P02_FlavorText_DESC: "You have no control. People like you never did." -Hak Ji-woon
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K23P02_GameplayText_DESC:
The first time a Survivor medium or fast-vaults a Window, a Dull Totem ignites.

The last {Tunable.K23P02.MaximumVaultsBlocked} Windows Survivors medium or fast-vault are blocked.

You basic-vault blocked Windows {Tunable.K23P02.VaultSpeedIncrease%}% faster.

You see the Auras of blocked Windows within {Tunable.K23P02.AuraRevealDistance}m.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K23P03_FlavorText_DESC: "That sound when you bleed...let me hear it again." -Hak Ji-woon
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K23P03_GameplayText_DESC:
The first time you Hook each Survivor, you earn {Tunable.K23P03.TokensPerUniqueHook} Token.

When all Generators are completed, when a Survivor starts opening an Exit Gate:
  • It is blocked {Tunable.K23P03.GateBlockBaseDuration}s, plus {Tunable.K23P03.GateBlockDurationPerToken}s for each Token.
  • You are alerted.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K24P01_FlavorText_DESC: "...it knows what it wants and won't stop till it gets it." -Carlos Oliveira
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K24P01_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, you see the Auras of all Survivors for {Tunable.K24P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

Whenever you see a Survivor's Aura for a duration, it is {Tunable.K24P01.BonusAuraRevealDuration}s longer.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K24P02_FlavorText_DESC: "Sorry I got a little jumpy there. Didn't know quite what to expect." -Robert Kendo
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K24P02_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever a healthy Survivor becomes injured, all injured Survivors gain {Keyword.Oblivious} for {Tunable.K24P02.ObliviousDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K24P02.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K24P03_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you damage a Generator, when you down a Survivor, all Generators damaged this way:
  • Explode, lose {Tunable.K24P03.GeneratorRegress%}% progress and start regressing.
  • Survivors repairing them scream, then you see their Auras for {Tunable.K24P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.


Cooldown: {Tunable.K24P03.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K25P01_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever a Generator is completed, the Generator with the most progress is blocked for {Tunable.K25P01.GeneratorBlockDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K25P02_FlavorText_DESC: "We came. Now you must come with us. Taste our pleasures." -Pinhead
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K25P02_GameplayText_DESC:
The first time you hook each Survivor, they are hexed and a Dull Totem ignites.

For {Tunable.K25P02.TotemBlockDuration}s, the Hex Totem is blocked to other Survivors.

The hexed Survivors:
  • Gain {Keyword.Oblivious}.
  • Within {Tunable.K25P02.TotemAuraRevealDistance}m of the Hex totem, they see its Aura.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K25P03_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook:
  • They gain {Keyword.Hemorrhage} for {Tunable.K25P03.MangledHemorrhageDuration}s.
  • They gain {Keyword.Mangled} for {Tunable.K25P03.MangledHemorrhageDuration}s.
  • When they are healed, until they take damage, they heal and repair {Tunable.K25P03.ActionSpeedDebuff%}% slower.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K26P01_FlavorText_DESC: "Are we nothing but prisoners to our sorrow?" -Carmina Mora
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K26P01_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you Hook a Survivor for the first time, earn {Tunable.K26P01.TokensPerUniqueHook} Token.

When you move {Tunable.K26P01.HookedDistance}m away from the hooked Survivor, all Generators are blocked for {Tunable.K26P01.GeneratorBlockDuration}s.

When you have {Tunable.K26P01.SurvivorsToBeHooked} Tokens, when you move {Tunable.K26P01.HookedDistance}m away from the hooked Survivor:
  • All Generators are blocked for {Tunable.K26P01.FinalGeneratorBlockDuration}s.
  • You see the Obsession's Aura for {Tunable.K26P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K26P02_FlavorText_DESC: "The pain spills beyond flesh/darkness staining the horizon." -Girl in the Shadow by Carmina Mora
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K26P02_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts:
  • 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
  • You earn {Tunable.K26P02.StartingTokens} Tokens.


The first time each Survivor is hooked on a Scourge Hook, spend {Tunable.K26P02.TokensSpentOnUniqueHook} Token, then the Generator with the most progress:
  • Explodes, loses {Tunable.K26P02.GeneratorRegression%}% progress and starts regressing.
  • Survivors repairing it scream.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K26P03_FlavorText_DESC: “A pentimento is concealed art. There is often a desire to see that which is beyond." -A Guide to Art & Process
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K26P03_GameplayText_DESC:
You see the Auras of cleansed Totems, and can rekindle each once.

Within {Tunable.K26P03.TotemAuraReveaDistance}m, Survivors see the Auras of Rekindled Totems.

While a totem is rekindled, Survivors heal and repair {Tunable.K26P03.BaseActionSpeedPenalty%}% slower, plus {Tunable.K26P03.ActionSpeedPenaltyPerTotem%}% for each additional Rekindled Totem.

When all {Tunable.K26P03.MaxTokens} Totems are rekindled at once, they are blocked.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K27P01_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked from a Scourge Hook, you see the Auras of other Survivors for {Tunable.K27P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K27P02_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you damage a Generator, it regresses {Tunable.K27P02.RegressionModifier%}% faster for {Tunable.K27P02.Duration}s.

For that time, whenever a Survivor hits a good basic Skill Check while repairing that Generator, you are alerted.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K27P03_GameplayText_DESC: The first time each Generator has {Tunable.K27P03.GeneratorProgressionRequired%}% progress: Survivors repairing it get special Skill Checks. If they miss one of these or stop repairing, that Generator is blocked for {Tunable.K27P03.GeneratorBlockedDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K28P01_FlavorText_DESC: "The Garden shall be a place of perfect Joy; through Joy, nothing shall stand in our way." -Otto Stamper
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K28P01_GameplayText_DESC: {Tunable.K28P01.TimeBeforeTrigger}s after a Survivor takes damage, for {Tunable.K28P01.EffectDuration}s, the next time a Survivor fast-vaults a Pallet while within your Terror Radius, it is destroyed.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K28P02_FlavorText_DESC: "Stay in the light, my children. In darkness, your fear will expose you." -Otto Stamper
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K28P02_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you search a Locker, you see the Auras of Survivors within {Tunable.K28P02.DetectionDistance}m of Lockers for {Tunable.K28P02.AuraRevealDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K28P02.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K28P03_FlavorText_DESC: "Do not admit to fear, or pain, or doubt. These are the seeds from which darkness grows." -Otto Stamper
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K28P03_GameplayText_DESC:
While a Survivor within your Terror Radius is healing:
  • They gain {Keyword.Blindness}.
  • They gain {Keyword.Exhausted}.


When they stop healing, this ends after {Tunable.K28P03.BlindnessExhaustionDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K29P01_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever a Survivor fast-vaults within {Tunable.K29P01.SurvivorVaultDistance}m of you, the next time you basic-vault a window, it is {Tunable.K29P01.VaultSpeed%}% faster. Cooldown: {Tunable.K29P01.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K29P02_GameplayText_DESC: While carrying a Survivor, within {Tunable.K29P02.AuraRevealDistance}m of you, you see the Auras of other Survivors.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K29P03_GameplayText_DESC:
When all Generators are completed: all injured, downed, and hooked Survivors gain {Keyword.Broken}.

When an Exit Gate is opened, this ends after {Tunable.K29P03.BrokenDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K30P01_FlavorText_DESC: "Out with you, cowards! Show yourselves!" -Tarhos Kovács
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K30P01_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you damage a Generator, for {Tunable.K30P01.AuraRevealDuration}s, you see the Auras of Survivors within {Tunable.K30P01.AuraRevealDistance}m of you.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K30P02_FlavorText_DESC: "I shall make an example of one. These mewling worms will never know peace."-Tarhos Kovács
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K30P02_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you damage a Survivor, they are hexed and a Dull Totem ignites.

Every {Tunable.K30P02.ScreamInterval}s, other Survivors not within your Terror Radius scream, then you see their Auras for {Tunable.K30P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.

When the hexed Survivor is downed or becomes healthy, the Hex Totem is extinguished.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K30P03_FlavorText_DESC: "You have made a grave mistake, standing in opposition to me this day." -Tarhos Kovács
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K30P03_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you are stunned by a Survivor, they gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K30P03.ExposedDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K30P03.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K31P01_FlavorText_DESC: “This one might actually be a challenge... ” -Adriana Imai
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K31P01_GameplayText_DESC:
While chasing the Obsession, whenever you basic-break Pallets or Breakable Walls, or damage Generators, you gain {Tunable.K31P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K31P01.HasteDuration}s.

Whenever you damage the Survivor with the most chase time with a basic-attack, they become the Obsession.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K31P02_FlavorText_DESC: “All those who stood in her path feared her mighty THWACK!” -Sonhadores Sombrios, Issue #3
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K31P02_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, you earn {Tunable.K31P02.StartingTokens} Tokens, up to {Tunable.K31P02.MaxTokens}.

Whenever you hook a Survivor, you earn {Tunable.K31P02.TokenGainOnHook} Token.

Whenever you break a Pallet or Breakable Wall, spend {Tunable.K31P02.TokensSpentPerBreak} Token. Then, all Survivors within {Tunable.K31P02.Range}m scream and you see their Auras for {Tunable.K31P02.RevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K31P03_FlavorText_DESC: “Good. Now we can move in for the kill.” -Adriana Imai
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K31P03_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever a Survivor unhooks another or themselves, they heal {Tunable.K31P03.HealPenalty%}% slower for {Tunable.K31P03.ReduceHealingDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K32P01_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever a Survivor takes damage, they gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.K32P01.ExhaustionDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K32P02_FlavorText_DESC: “THE ORGANIC MIND’S CAPACITY FOR EMPATHY GOES BEYOND HINDRANCE.” -HUX-A7-13
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K32P02_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you down a Survivor, other Survivors within {Tunable.K32P02.RequiredDistance}m of the downed Survivor gain {Tunable.K32P02.Hinder%}% {Keyword.Hindered} for {Tunable.K32P02.HinderedDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K32P02.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K32P03_FlavorText_DESC: “YOU WILL HOLD NO DOMINION OVER ME.” -HUX-A7-13
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K32P03_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you damage a Generator, it becomes Compromised.

When that Generator is completed by Survivors:
  • You gain {Tunable.K32P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K32P03.PerkDuration}s.
  • You gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for {Tunable.K32P03.PerkDuration}s.


Only one Generator can be compromised at a time.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K33P01_FlavorText_DESC: “I can't lie to you about your chances, but... you have my sympathies.” -Ash
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K33P01_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you search a Locker, Survivors within {Tunable.K33P01.RequiredDistance}m:
  • Gain {Keyword.Blindness} for {Tunable.K33P01.BlindnessDuration}s.
  • Scream.


Cooldown: {Tunable.K33P01.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K33P02_FlavorText_DESC: “Catch it, put it in the airlock, get rid of it.” -Dallas
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K33P02_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack, you gain {Tunable.K33P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K33P02.HasteDuration}s.

While chasing a Survivor, you cannot gain Bloodlust.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K33P03_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you hook a Survivor, the farthest injured Survivor:
  • Gains {Keyword.Oblivious} for {Tunable.K33P03.ObliviousDuration}s.
  • You see their Aura for {Tunable.K33P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K34P01_FlavorText_DESC: “From now on, no more Mr. Good Guy.” -Chucky
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K34P01_GameplayText_DESC:
While this Hex is dull, each time you are blinded or stunned by a Survivor {Tunable.K34P01.StunnedOrBlindedTimesRequired} times, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you are blinded or stunned by a Survivor you are not carrying, they are blinded for {Tunable.K34P01.BlindedDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K34P02_FlavorText_DESC: "I got some fresh meat lined up, and I'm not gonna let you spoil it, not this time!" -Chucky
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K34P02_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you Hook a Survivor that is not the Obsession:
  • The Obsession gains {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K34P02.ExposedDuration}s.
  • You see the Obsession's Aura for {Tunable.K34P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.


Whenever you Hook the Obsession, another Survivor:
  • Screams, then you are alerted.
  • Becomes the Obsession.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K34P03_GameplayText_DESC: Within {Tunable.K34P03.RequiredDistance}m of a completed Generator, you gain {Tunable.K34P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}. When you leave the range, this ends after {Tunable.K34P03.HasteLingerDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K35P01_FlavorText_DESC: "I heard it. Running. It was getting closer!” -Anonymous Testimony, 09/09/1979
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K35P01_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever a healthy Survivor becomes injured, for the next {Tunable.K35P01.EffectDuration}s, whenever you basic-vault a window, gain {Tunable.K35P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K35P01.HasteDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K35P02_FlavorText_DESC: "Mom, if you find this, I’m sorry...” -Final Journal Entry, 07/12/1991
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K35P02_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you damage a Generator:
  • Your Terror Radius is set to that Generator for {Tunable.K35P02.EffectDuration}s and its radius is {Tunable.K35P02.TerrorRadiusSize}m.
  • You gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for that time.


Cooldown: {Tunable.K35P02.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K35P03_FlavorText_DESC: "Erratic behavior in machinery could be related to [REDACTED], further testing required.” -OSS Report, 12/02/1943
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K35P03_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever a Survivor misses a basic Skill Check, earn {Tunable.K35P03.TokenGain} Tokens, up to {Tunable.K35P03.MaxTokens}.

Whenever you damage a Generator, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent:
  • The Generator loses {Tunable.K35P03.GeneratorRegressionPerToken%}% progress.
  • The Generator is blocked for {Tunable.K35P03.BlockTimePerToken}s.


When that Generator is unblocked, it begins regressing. Cooldown: {Tunable.K35P03.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K36P01_FlavorText_DESC: “No number of novelties will protect you from me!” -Vecna
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K36P01_GameplayText_DESC:
The first time each item is depleted, it is dropped.

While a Survivor is within {Tunable.K36P01.AuraRevealDistance}m of a dropped item:
  • You see their Aura.
  • They see the item's Aura.


Whenever a Survivor picks-up an item, they gain {Keyword.Oblivious} for {Tunable.K36P01.ObliviousDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K36P02_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever a Survivor within {Tunable.K36P02.RangeFromKiller}m of you scares a Crow, they gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.K36P02.ExhaustedDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K36P02.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K36P03_FlavorText_DESC: “Run all you want. I will not be denied.” -Vecna
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K36P03_GameplayText_DESC:
You basic-vault Windows {Tunable.K36P03.VaultSpeedIncrease%}% faster.

Whenever you are blinded or Pallet-stunned, the duration is {Tunable.K36P03.ExtraBlindStunDuration%}% longer.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K37P01_FlavorText_DESC: "So toil, mortal, toil! Your effort will be for naught!" -Dracula
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K37P01_GameplayText_DESC:
The first time a Generator is completed, a Dull Totem ignites.

The Obsession:
  • Repairs {Tunable.K37P01.RepairSpeedPenalty%}% slower.
  • Sees the Hex Totem's Aura within {Tunable.K37P01.AuraRevealDistance}m.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K37P02_FlavorText_DESC: "Come running, one and all, and see what fortune awaits you." -Dracula
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K37P02_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever a Survivor gets within {Tunable.K37P02.AuraRevealRange}m of a locked Chest, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K37P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.

You can lock unlocked Chests. Cooldown: {Tunable.K37P02.Cooldown}s.

You see the Auras of locked Chests.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K37P03_FlavorText_DESC: "Tragic, is it not? How powerless you must feel." -Dracula
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K37P03_GameplayText_DESC: The first time each Chest is being unlocked and each Totem is being blessed or cleansed by a Survivor, it is blocked for {Tunable.K37P03.BlockDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K38P01_FlavorText_DESC: "Go on. Run. Tell your friends I'm coming for them." -Portia Maye
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K38P01_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you fall from at least {Tunable.K38P01.RequiredFallHeight}m, your lunge-attacks are {Tunable.K38P01.LungeAttackExtra%}% longer for {Tunable.K38P01.EffectDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K38P01.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K38P02_FlavorText_DESC: "Drop anchor! I will chart us a new course." -Portia Maye
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K38P02_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.

Whenever a Survivor is unhooked, the Hook becomes a Scourge Hook.

Whenever you hook a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, for {Tunable.K38P02.GeneratorRevealDuration}s, you see the Aura of the Generator with the most progress.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K38P03_FlavorText_DESC: "Fire another broadside! Don't stop until the sea takes them!" -Portia Maye
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K38P03_GameplayText_DESC: While self-healing, whenever a Survivor has {Tunable.K38P03.SelfHealTrigger%}% progress, they get special Skill Checks. If they miss one of these or stop healing, they gain {Keyword.Broken} for {Tunable.K38P03.BrokenDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K39P01_FlavorText_DESC: "All of the liabilities of this world are due to the inadequacies of the person involved." -Ken Kaneki
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K39P01_GameplayText_DESC:
After you damage Survivors with a basic-attack {Tunable.K39P01.BasicHitsRequired} times, a Dull Totem ignites.

Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack, they gain {Tunable.K39P01.Hindered%}% {Keyword.Hindered} for {Tunable.K39P01.HinderedDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K39P02_FlavorText_DESC: "You tried to devour me so you have no room to complain if I eat you, do you?" -Ken Kaneki
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K39P02_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever a Survivor takes damage, you earn {Tunable.K39P02.TokensPerDamage} Token, up to {Tunable.K39P02.MaxTokens}.

For each Token:
  • You hook Survivors {Tunable.K39P02.BonusPerToken%}% faster.
  • You pick-up and drop Survivors {Tunable.K39P02.BonusPerToken%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K39P03_FlavorText_DESC: "I'm not wrong. What's wrong is this messed-up world!" -Ken Kaneki
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K39P03_GameplayText_DESC:
The first time you hook each Survivor, earn {Tunable.K39P03.TokensPerUniqueHook} Token.

When all Generators are completed, for each Token:
  • Upright Pallets are blocked for {Tunable.K39P03.BlockDurationPerToken}s.
  • Windows are blocked for {Tunable.K39P03.BlockDurationPerToken}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K40P01_FlavorText_DESC: "You only think you are in control..." -Springtrap
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K40P01_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you damage a Generator, it is compromised.

When that Generator is completed by Survivors, your basic-attack cooldowns are {Tunable.K40P01.AttackCooldownReduction%}% shorter for {Tunable.K40P01.Duration}s.

Only 1 Generator can be compromised at a time.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K40P02_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever a Survivor within your Terror Radius looks at you, they scream, then you see their Aura for {Tunable.K40P02.AuraRevealDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K40P02.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K40P03_FlavorText_DESC: "There will be no redemption for you." -Springtrap
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K40P03_GameplayText_DESC:
Exit Gate Switches with at least {Tunable.K40P03.RegressionThreshold%}% progress regress at {Tunable.K40P03.RegressionRate%}% speed.

While they are regressing, Survivors see the Exit Gate Lights flicker randomly.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K41P01_FlavorText_DESC: “Weeping Ginevra’s blood streams/The devil smells the weak.” -Fabbro Barone’s Ginevra
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K41P01_GameplayText_DESC:
The first time you hook each Survivor, you earn {Tunable.K41P01.TokensPerUniqueHook} Token.

When you have {Tunable.K41P01.MaxTokens} Tokens, all Survivors:
  • Scream.
  • Gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K41P01.ExposedDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K41P02_FlavorText_DESC: “A drop does not satiate/when a river is needed.” -Elliot Campbell’s Grandeur of Samuel
