PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K41P02_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you start chasing a Survivor, for the next {Tunable.K41P02.RevealDuration}s, you see the Auras of all other injured Survivors within {Tunable.K41P02.RevealDistance}m. Cooldown: {Tunable.K41P02.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K41P03_FlavorText_DESC: “From salvation’s ruin, be warned/death comes from all around.” -Giovanni Serrata’s Fog Hill
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K41P03_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, a Dull Totem ignites and hexes the farthest Generator from it.

After a Survivor repairs the hexed Generator for {Tunable.K41P03.RequiredTime} seconds:
  • You gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for {Tunable.K41P03.TerrorRadiusDisplacementDuration}s.
  • For that time, your Terror Radius is set to that Generator.


When the hexed Generator is repaired, the next farthest Generator is hexed.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K42P01_FlavorText_DESC: “Nothing will happen to you... Nothing that you don’t deserve!” -Henry Creel
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K42P01_GameplayText_DESC: After hooking a Survivor, for the next {Tunable.K42P01.Duration}s, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to make target Generator you can see within {Tunable.K42P01.Range}m explode, lose {Tunable.K42P01.GeneratorRegression%}% progress and start regressing.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K42P02_FlavorText_DESC: “You are a prisoner here, just like me.” -Henry Creel
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K42P02_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever a totem is blessed or cleansed, a random unblocked Generator is blocked for {Tunable.K42P02.BlockDuration}s.

Whenever 1 or more Generators are blocked, you gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for {Tunable.K42P02.UndetectableDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K42P03_FlavorText_DESC: “You... let us in. And now, you are going to have to let us stay.” -Henry Creel
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_K42P03_GameplayText_DESC:
The first time you hook a Survivor, a Dull Totem ignites.

The Auras of Generators show their progress.

When {Tunable.K42P03.GeneratorsToActivate} Generator remains:
  • All Generators explode, lose {Tunable.K42P03.GeneratorRegression%}% progress and start regressing.
  • The Hex Totem is extinguished.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Kindred_FlavorText_DESC: “Be kind to one another. We’re all in this together.” -Lost Tapes: Sujan
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Kindred_GameplayText_DESC:
While you are hooked, all Survivors see each others' Auras. While the Killer is within {Tunable.SG_Kindred.AuraRevealDistance}m, all Survivors sees the Killer's Aura.

While another Survivor is hooked, you see the Auras of other Survivors. While the Killer is within {Tunable.SG_Kindred.AuraRevealDistance}m of the hooked Survivor, you see the Killer's Aura.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Leader_GameplayText_DESC:
Within {Tunable.S01P02.Range}m of you, other Survivors:
  • Cleanse Totems {Tunable.S01P02.ActionSpeedModifier%}% faster.
  • Heal {Tunable.S01P02.ActionSpeedModifier%}% faster.
  • Open Exit Gates {Tunable.S01P02.ActionSpeedModifier%}% faster.
  • Sabotage Hooks {Tunable.S01P02.ActionSpeedModifier%}% faster.
  • Unhook Survivors {Tunable.S01P02.ActionSpeedModifier%}% faster.
  • Unlock Chests {Tunable.S01P02.ActionSpeedModifier%}% faster.


After they leave your range, this ends after {Tunable.S01P02.LingerDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_LeftBehind_FlavorText_DESC: "I'm not horseshittin' around. I'm doing this alone!" -Bill
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_LeftBehind_GameplayText_DESC: When all other Survivors are dead, while within {Tunable.S08P01.HatchRevealDistance}m of the Hatch, you see its Aura.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Lightborn_FlavorText_DESC: "These monsters… they adapt! They emerge with strange new abilities." -Vigo's Journal
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Lightborn_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever a Survivor attempts to blind you, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K03P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.

You cannot be blinded.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Lightweight_FlavorText_DESC: "Take it slow, he knows where you've been… just like I've always said: live slow and die old." -Lost Tapes: Dylan
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Lightweight_GameplayText_DESC: Your Scratch Marks disappear {Tunable.SG_Lightweight.ScratchmarksTimeReduction}s faster and appear more spread out.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Lithe_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you medium or fast-vault:
  • You gain {Tunable.S09P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S09P02.HasteDuration}s.
  • You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S09P02.ExhaustionDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_LuckyBreak_FlavorText_DESC: “That’s not enough to beat me. Not even close.” -Yui Kimura
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_LuckyBreak_GameplayText_DESC:
While injured, for up to {Tunable.S20P01.MaxDuration}s:
  • You leave no Pools of Blood.
  • You leave no Scratch Marks.


For each second spent healing another Survivor, recharge the duration by {Tunable.S20P01.TimePerHealingSecond}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_MadGrit_FlavorText_DESC: “There’s no getting out of this now. We’re too good at it.” -The Legion
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_MadGrit_GameplayText_DESC:
While carrying a Survivor:
  • Whenever you miss a basic-attack, your cooldown is {Tunable.K14P02.AttackCooldownReduction}% shorter.
  • Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic attack, the carried Survivor gains no wiggle progress for {Tunable.K14P02.WigglePauseDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_MakeYourChoice_FlavorText_DESC: "You'd be surprised what tools can save a life." -Amanda Young
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_MakeYourChoice_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever a Survivor unhooks another or themselves while you are at least {Tunable.K11P03.MinimumDistance}m away:
  • They scream.
  • They gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.K11P03.ExposedDuration}s.


Cooldown: {Tunable.K11P03.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Mindbreaker_FlavorText_DESC: "The specimen's apparent telepathic ability can evoke feelings of dread and fatigue in nearby individuals." -Hawkins National Laboratory
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Mindbreaker_GameplayText_DESC:
While Survivors are repairing a Generator:
  • They gain {Keyword.Blindness}.
  • They gain {Keyword.Exhausted}.


When they stop repairing a Generator, this ends after {Tunable.K17P03.LingerDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_MonitorAndAbuse_GameplayText_DESC:
While chasing a Survivor, your Terror Radius is {Tunable.K07P02.TerrorRadiusIncrease%}% bigger.

While not chasing a Survivor, your Terror Radius is {Tunable.K07P02.TerrorRadiusDecrease%}% smaller.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_MonstrousShrine_FlavorText_DESC: "Then you will know that there is no escape. When hanging in the depths, you face the dark one."
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_MonstrousShrine_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts:
  • 4 random Hooks become Scourge Hooks.
  • The Basement Hooks become Scourge Hooks.


While you are at least {Tunable.KG_Monstrous_Shrine.Range}m away from a Survivor on a Scourge Hook, they are sacrificed {Tunable.KG_Monstrous_Shrine.FasterProgress%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Nemesis_FlavorText_DESC: “Only a fool would spit in a demon’s face and declare victory.” -Renjiro’s Doctrine 4:9
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Nemesis_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever a Survivor blinds you, Locker-stuns or Pallet-stuns you, they become the Obsession.

Whenever a Survivor becomes the Obsession:
  • They gain {Keyword.Oblivious} for {Tunable.K18P03.ObliviousDuration}s.
  • You see their Aura for {Tunable.K18P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_NoMither_FlavorText_DESC: “I lost it and lamped him one. Had a few pints afterwards, moved on. Couldn’t be mithered with it. Can’t be arsed.” -David King
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_NoMither_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, you become injured, then:
  • You gain {Keyword.Broken}.
  • Your Grunts of Pain are {Tunable.S10P03.InjuredVoiceLevelReduction%}% quieter.
  • You leave no Pools of Blood.
  • You recover {Tunable.S10P03.ExtraRecover%}% faster.
  • You can fully recover.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_NoOneEscapesDeath_FlavorText_DESC: "And the beast became faster and more powerful as if The Entity's shadowy whips were lashing at its back."
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_NoOneEscapesDeath_GameplayText_DESC:
When all Generators are completed, a Dull Totem ignites:
  • Survivors gain {Keyword.Exposed}.
  • You gain {Tunable.KG_No_One_Escapes_Death.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.


Within {Tunable.KG_No_One_Escapes_Death.AuraRevealStartRange}m, Survivors see the Hex Totem's Aura, expanding to {Tunable.KG_No_One_Escapes_Death.AuraRevealEndRange}m over {Tunable.KG_No_One_Escapes_Death.AuraSizeIncreaseDelay}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_NoOneLeftBehind_FlavorText_DESC: “Yeah, no shit. But we can outsmart and overthrow him if we work together. Don't be predictable and selfish!” -Lost Tapes: Clyde
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_NoOneLeftBehind_GameplayText_DESC:
When all Generators are completed:
  • You heal {Tunable.SG_No_One_Left_Behind.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
  • You unhook other Survivors {Tunable.SG_No_One_Left_Behind.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
  • Whenever you unhook a Survivor, they gain {Tunable.SG_No_One_Left_Behind.IncreasedHaste%}% more {Keyword.Haste}.
  • You see the Auras of other Survivors.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_NurseCalling_FlavorText_DESC: “Still attached to the fragments of her past life, she is drawn to those in need of help.”
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_NurseCalling_GameplayText_DESC: Within {Tunable.K04P03.AuraRevealDistance}m of Survivors who are healing or being healed, you see their Auras.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_ObjectOfObsession_GameplayText_DESC:
While you are the Obsession, every {Tunable.S06P03.RevealTimeIntervals}s, the Killer sees your Aura for {Tunable.S06P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.

While the Killer sees your Aura:
  • You see their Aura.
  • You cleanse totems {Tunable.S06P03.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.
  • You heal {Tunable.S06P03.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.
  • You repair {Tunable.S06P03.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.


When the trial starts, you are more likely to be the Obsession.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_OffTheRecord_FlavorText_DESC: "Trust me, I investigate thoroughly and discreetly." -Zarina Kassir
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_OffTheRecord_GameplayText_DESC:
Until all Generators are completed, whenever you are unhooked, for the next {Tunable.S21P01.Duration}s:
  • You gain {Keyword.Endurance}.
  • Your Grunts of Pain are {Tunable.S21P01.InjuredVoiceLevelReduction%}% quieter.
  • The Killer cannot see your Aura.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_OpenHanded_FlavorText_DESC: “Paying attention is what kept me alive through the years. That, and my good looks of course.” -Ace
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_OpenHanded_GameplayText_DESC: All Survivors see Auras that have a range from {Tunable.S07P01.AuraIncreaseDistance}m farther.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_OverwhelmingPresence_GameplayText_D:
Whenever a Survivor uses an item within {Tunable.K07P01.DistanceToSurvivorDistance}m of you, they gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.K07P01.ExhaustionDuration}s.

Whenever a Survivor within {Tunable.K07P01.DistanceToSurvivorDistance}m of you gains {Keyword.Exhausted}, you see the closest {Keyword.Exhausted} Survivor's Aura for {Tunable.K07P01.AuraRevealDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K07P01.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Pharmacy_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you unlock a Chest, it will contain a rare Med-Kit.

You unlock Chests {Tunable.S11P02.SearchSpeeds%}% faster.

The range at which the Killer hears you unlocking Chests is {Tunable.S11P02.NoiseReductionDistance}m shorter.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_PlayWithYourFood_FlavorText_DESC: “You've fooled them, haven't you Michael? But not me.” -Dr. Sam Loomis
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_PlayWithYourFood_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you stop chasing the Obsession, you earn {Tunable.K06P03.TokensGained} Token, up to {Tunable.K06P03.MaxTokens}. Cooldown: {Tunable.K06P03.ChargeGainedCooldown}s.

For each Token, gain {Tunable.K06P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.

Whenever you attack, lose {Tunable.K06P03.TokensLostOnAction} Token.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_PlunderersInstinct_FlavorText_DESC: "The pioneers used to loot these babies for hours." -Lost Tapes: Aizeyu
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_PlunderersInstinct_GameplayText_DES:
Within {Tunable.SG_Plunderers_Instinct.ChestAuraRevealDistance}m of locked Chests and dropped items, you see their Auras.

Whenever you unlock a Chest, you are {Tunable.SG_Plunderers_Instinct.ModifyChestRarity}% more likely to find an item of higher rarity.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Poised_FlavorText_DESC: “Ok, stay calm. Don’t overthink it and just keep moving forward: you got this.” -Jane Romero
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Poised_GameplayText_DESC:
The first time you start repairing each Generator, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S16P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.

Whenever a Generator is completed, you leave no Scratch Marks for {Tunable.S16P02.StealthDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Predator_FlavorText_DESC: "Never stop moving and hope you're always two steps ahead of the beast." -Notebook
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Predator_GameplayText_DESC: When you stop chasing a Survivor, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K02P01.AuraRevealDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K02P01.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Premonition_FlavorText_DESC: "I have a bad feeling about this!"
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Premonition_GameplayText_DESC: While the Killer is within {Tunable.SG_Premonition.PerkEffectDistance}m of you and inside a {Tunable.SG_Premonition.ActivationAngle} degree cone, whenever you look at them, you hear a sound cue. Cooldown: {Tunable.SG_Premonition.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_ProveThyself_GameplayText_DESC: For each other Survivor within {Tunable.S01P03.Range}m of you, all Survivors repair {Tunable.S01P03.RepairBonusPerSurvivor%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_QuickQuiet_GameplayText_DESC: You hide in Lockers and vault silently. The Killer is not alerted. Cooldown: {Tunable.S02P01.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Rancor_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever a Generator is completed:
  • You are alerted to the position of all Survivors for {Tunable.K13P03.SurvivorRevealDuration}s.
  • The Obsession sees your Aura for {Tunable.K13P03.KillerRevealDuration}s.


When all Generators are completed:
  • The Obsession gains {Keyword.Exposed}.
  • You can Kill the Obsession.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_RedHerring_FlavorText_DESC: "The news edits out what is burdensome and complex, which is the truth." -Zarina Kassir
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_RedHerring_GameplayText_DESC:
After you repair a Generator for at least {Tunable.S21P02.TimeToActivate}s, you see its Aura.

When you hide in a Locker, the Killer is alerted to the Generator. Cooldown: {Tunable.S21P02.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_RememberMe_FlavorText_DESC: “You don't remember? You must. You're my number one, and you'll never wake up again.” -Freddy Krueger
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_RememberMe_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever the Obsession takes damage, you earn 1 Token, up to {Tunable.K10P02.MaximumTokens}.

For each Token, Survivors who are not the Obsession open Exit Gates {Tunable.K10P02.ActionSpeedPenalty%}% slower.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_RepressedAlliance_GameplayText_DESC: After repairing Generators for {Tunable.S22P03.RepairTimeNeeded}s, while repairing a Generator alone, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to block that generator for {Tunable.S22P03.GeneratorBlockDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Resilience_GameplayText_DESC:
While injured:
  • You bless and cleanse Totems {Tunable.SG_Resilience.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
  • You heal {Tunable.SG_Resilience.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
  • You open Exit Gates {Tunable.SG_Resilience.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
  • You repair {Tunable.SG_Resilience.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
  • You sabotage Hooks {Tunable.SG_Resilience.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
  • You unhook Survivors {Tunable.SG_Resilience.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
  • You unlock chests {Tunable.SG_Resilience.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
  • You vault {Tunable.SG_Resilience.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S24P01_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, you earn {Tunable.S24P01.StartingTokens} Tokens.

Spend {Tunable.S24P01.TokensPerRummage} Token to rummage an empty Chest, up to {Tunable.S24P01.MaxRummagesPerChest} times per Chest.

You rummage Chests {Tunable.S24P01.ChestSearchSpeedBonus%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S24P02_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you attempt to fast-enter a Locker:
  • You do not enter the Locker.
  • The Killer is alerted.
  • You leave no Pools of Blood for {Tunable.S24P02.NoScratchMarksDuration}s.
  • You leave no Scratch Marks for {Tunable.S24P02.NoScratchMarksDuration}s.


Cooldown: {Tunable.S24P02.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S24P03_FlavorText_DESC: “I relied on others to protect me once and I lost everything. Never again.” -Élodie Rakoto
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S24P03_GameplayText_DESC:
While carried by the Killer, while you have at least {Tunable.S24P03.WiggleRequired%}% wiggle and next to an Upright Pallet, you can drop it to stun the Killer.

While downed, you see the Auras of Upright Pallets.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S25P01_FlavorText_DESC: "The weak are sacrificed first. It's nature, it's business... it's the truth most refuse to face." -Yun-jin
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S25P01_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you unhook another Survivor, you earn {Tunable.S25P01.TokensPerHook} Token, up to {Tunable.S25P01.MaxTokens}.

While repairing, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent, the Generator gains {Tunable.S25P01.BonusPerToken%}% permanent progress.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S25P02_FlavorText_DESC: "I've dealt with psychopaths in suits. You're just uglier and worse dressed." -Yun-jin
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S25P02_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you Pallet-stun the Killer:
  • You gain {Tunable.S25P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S25P02.HasteDuration}s.
  • You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S25P02.ExhaustedDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S25P03_FlavorText_DESC: "Something I learned in the industry: when the axe is swinging, keep your head down." -Yun-jin
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S25P03_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever another Survivor is hooked, you gain {Keyword.Elusive} for {Tunable.S25P03.Duration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S26P01_FlavorText_DESC: "I don't mind a little detective work." -Jill Valentine
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S26P01_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, you earn {Tunable.S26P01.StartingTokens} Token.

Whenever you cleanse a Totem, earn {Tunable.S26P01.TokensPerCleanse} Token, then, you see the Aura of the farthest Totem for {Tunable.S26P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

For each Token, you cleanse Totems {Tunable.S26P01.StackableCleanseSpeed%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S26P02_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you are unhooked, you gain {Tunable.S26P02.HealRegain%}% healing progress.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S26P03_FlavorText_DESC: "You want S.T.A.R.S.? I'll give you S.T.A.R.S.! " -Jill Valentine
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S26P03_GameplayText_DESC:
After repairing {Tunable.S26P03.RequiredProgress%}% of Generators, while next to a Generator, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to trap it for {Tunable.S26P03.TrapDuration}s. All Survivors see that Generator's Aura for that time.

When the Killer damages that Generator, the trap explodes, then:
  • They are stunned for {Tunable.S26P03.StunBlindDuration}s.
  • Everyone nearby looking at the detonation is blinded.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S27P01_GameplayText_DESC:
While healing, you and the healed Survivor make no noises or Grunts of Pain. Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check:
  • You lose only {Tunable.S27P01.OverrideHealFailPenalty%}% progress.
  • The Killer is not alerted.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S27P02_GameplayText_DESC:
After repairing {Tunable.S27P02.RequiredProgressToCraft%}% of Generators, while hiding in a Locker, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to craft a Flashbang.

When you use the Flashbang:
  • Everyone nearby looking at the detonation is blinded.
  • The Killer is alerted.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S27P03_FlavorText_DESC: "I'll stop this, lieutenant. I promise." -Leon S. Kennedy
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S27P03_GameplayText_DESC: After you hit {Tunable.S27P03.SkillchecksRequiredAmount} basic repair Skill Checks, while a Generator is regressing, you see its Aura.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S28P01_FlavorText_DESC: "Does anyone else see that? Just me?" -Mikaela Reid
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S28P01_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you bless or cleanse a Totem, while not holding an item, use {Input.UseItem} to, for up to {Tunable.S28P01.AuraRevealDuration}s and within {Tunable.S28P01.AuraRevealDistance}m:
  • See the Auras of Chests.
  • See the Auras of Exit Gate Switches.
  • See the Auras of Generators.
  • See the Aura of the Hatch.
  • See the Auras of Hooks.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S28P02_FlavorText_DESC: "Try this, it’s better than anything you’ll find in a pharmacy." -Mikaela Reid
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S28P02_GameplayText_DESC:
While next to a totem, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons.

Survivors within the Boon's range:
  • While healing without a Med-Kit, they heal others {Tunable.S28P02.HealingSpeedBonus%}% faster.
  • While injured, other Survivors see their Aura.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S28P03_FlavorText_DESC: "Stick to the shadows and cover your tracks." -Mikaela Reid
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S28P03_GameplayText_DESC:
While next to a Totem, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons. Survivors within the Boon's range:
  • Leave no Scratch Marks.
  • Their Auras cannot be seen by the Killer.


When leaving the range, this ends after {Tunable.S28P03.LingerDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S29P01_FlavorText_DESC: "After careful analysis, we're getting the hell out of here!" -Jonah Vasquez
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S29P01_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you take damage:
  • You retain your speed boost for {Tunable.S29P01.ExtraBoostTime}s longer.
  • You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S29P01.ExhaustionDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S29P02_FlavorText_DESC: "Can't hurt to have another set of eyes on the problem." -Jonah Vasquez
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S29P02_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, you earn {Tunable.S29P02.StartingTokens} Tokens, up to {Tunable.S29P02.MaxTokens}.

Whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, earn {Tunable.S29P02.TokensGainedPerGreat} Token.

Whenever another Survivor misses a basic Skill Check, spend {Tunable.S29P02.TokensSpentPerMiss} Token:
  • The missed Skill Check becomes a good Skill Check.
  • You see that Survivor's Aura for {Tunable.S29P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S29P03_FlavorText_DESC: "It's not our time to die... probably." -Jonah Vasquez
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S29P03_GameplayText_DESC:
While next to a totem, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to bless it, creating a unique Boon totem that combines all your Boons.

Downed Survivors within the Boon's range:
  • Recover {Tunable.S29P03.RecoverSpeedBoost%}% faster.
  • Can fully recover.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S30P01_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you stun the Killer, for {Tunable.S30P01.StealthDuration}s:
  • You make no Grunts of Pain.
  • You leave no Pools of Blood.
  • You leave no Scratch Marks.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S30P02_GameplayText_DESC:
You heal other Survivors {Tunable.S30P02.HealingBonus%}% faster.

Injured Survivors see your Aura.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S30P03_GameplayText_DESC:
While next to a totem, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to bless it, creating a unique Boon Totem that combines all your Boons.

Survivors within the Boon's range gain {Tunable.S30P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}. When leaving the range, this ends after {Tunable.S30P03.LingerDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S31P01_FlavorText_DESC: "The death, the trauma, the fear… it all leads here. The Overlap." -Haddie Kaur, Ravages of the Abyss Episode 11
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S31P01_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever the Killer damages another Survivor, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S31P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

You see other Survivors' Scratch Marks.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S31P02_FlavorText_DESC: "I’ll never see what Haddie sees. But so long as I’m with her, I know I’m safe." -Jordan Rois, Ravages of the Abyss Episode 5
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S31P02_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you blind the Killer, they gain {Keyword.Blindness} for {Tunable.S31P02.BlindnessDuration}s.

You can rummage Chests {Tunable.S31P02.MaxRummagePerChest} time. The first time you rummage a Chest, it will contain an uncommon Flashlight.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S31P03_FlavorText_DESC: "The Ravage senses us. We need to work fast." -Haddie Kaur, Ravages of the Abyss Episode 9
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S31P03_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you bless or cleanse a Totem, until you take damage, you repair {Tunable.S31P03.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster. If that Totem was a Hex Totem, the effect is doubled.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S32P01_GameplayText_DESC:
After repairing {Tunable.S32P01.RequiredProgress%}% of Generators, while next to a Generator, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to trap it for {Tunable.S32P01.TrapDuration}s or until the Killer damages that Generator. All Survivors see that Generator's Aura for that time.

While the Killer is within {Tunable.S32P01.AuraRevealRange}m of that Generator, all Survivors see the Killer's Aura.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S32P02_GameplayText_DESC: While injured, whenever another Survivor within {Tunable.S32P02.MaximumDistance}m of you takes damage, you gain {Tunable.S32P02.HealingProgressionIncrease%}% missing healing progress.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S32P03_GameplayText_DESC:
When all other Survivors are downed or hooked, for {Tunable.S32P03.EffectDuration}s:
  • You make no Grunts of Pain.
  • You leave no Pools of Blood.
  • You leave no Scratch Marks.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S33P01_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, until they take damage:
  • They bless and cleanse {Tunable.S33P01.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.
  • They heal {Tunable.S33P01.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.
  • They unlock Chests {Tunable.S33P01.ActionSpeedBonus%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S33P02_GameplayText_DESC: Once per Hook State, while within {Tunable.S33P02.RadiusDistance}m of a hooked Survivor, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to stop the sacrifice progress for {Tunable.S33P02.StrugglePauseDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S33P03_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you earn {Tunable.S33P03.TokensPerGreat} Token, up to {Tunable.S33P03.MaxTokens}.

For each Token, basic Skill Checks:
  • Appear {Tunable.S33P03.SkillCheckBonusChance%}% more often.
  • Spin {Tunable.S33P03.SkillCheckSpeedIncrease%}% faster.
  • Whenever you hit a great, give {Tunable.S33P03.SkillCheckBonusPerToken%}% more progress.


Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, hit a good Skill Check, or stop healing or repairing, lose all Tokens.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S34P01_FlavorText_DESC: "When you look a layer deeper, you realize… everything is connected." -Vittorio Toscano
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S34P01_GameplayText_DESC:
While repairing, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to earn Tokens instead of progress, up to {Tunable.S34P01.MaxTokens} Tokens.

While you have at least {Tunable.S34P01.TokensToActivate} Token, {Input.ActivatableButton2} to spend all Tokens and gain {Tunable.S34P01.ProgressPerToken%}% progress for each Token spent.

Whenever you take damage, lose all Tokens.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S34P02_FlavorText_DESC: "I have seen great cruelty… and I have also seen another way. " -Vittorio Toscano
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S34P02_GameplayText_DESC: While repairing, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S34P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S34P03_FlavorText_DESC: "We need not resort to violence. And I shall prove it." -Vittorio Toscano
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S34P03_GameplayText_DESC:
While chased by the Killer:
  • You see the Auras of other Survivors.
  • Other Survivors repair {Tunable.S34P03.RepairBoost%}% faster.


Whenever you take damage, cooldown: {Tunable.S34P03.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S35P01_FlavorText_DESC: “I know how we can get out of here. Quick, this way.” -Thalita Lyra
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S35P01_GameplayText_DESC:
While chased by the Killer, whenever you medium or fast-vault:
  • For up to {Tunable.S35P01.StealthDuration}s, your medium and fast vaults are silent.
  • During that time, whenever you medium or fast-vault, the timer is reset.


Cooldown: {Tunable.S35P01.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S35P02_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you finish repairing a Generator with at least 1 other Survivor, Survivors who finished repairing it repair {Tunable.S35P02.ExtraRepairSpeed%}% faster for {Tunable.S35P02.BoostDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S35P03_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, while you stay within {Tunable.S35P03.RequiredDistance}m of each other, you both gain {Tunable.S35P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}. When either of you leaves the range, this ends after {Tunable.S35P03.LingerDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S36P01_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever the Killer picks-up another Survivor, for the next {Tunable.S36P01.EffectDuration}s, when you start running:
  • Gain {Tunable.S36P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S36P01.HasteDuration}s.
  • Gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S36P01.ExhaustedDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S36P02_GameplayText_DESC:
Until all Generators are completed, whenever you are unhooked, for the next {Tunable.S36P02.EffectDuration}s, while {Keyword.Exhausted}, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to lose {Keyword.Exhausted} instantly.

This is disabled by conspicuous actions.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S36P03_FlavorText_DESC: “I’m good, I’m good… but keep it down.” -Renato Lyra
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S36P03_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever another Survivor finishes healing you, while within {Tunable.S36P03.RequiredDistance}m of each other, you both leave no Scratch Marks. When either of you leaves the range, this ends after {Tunable.S36P03.LingerDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S37P01_FlavorText_DESC: “Nothing gets done around here if I don’t do it.” -Gabriel Soma
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S37P01_GameplayText_DESC:
While chased by the Killer:
  • You see the Aura of the Generator with the most progress.
  • Whenever you drop a Pallet, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S37P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.


When the Killer stops chasing you, this ends after {Tunable.S37P01.LingeringDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S37P02_FlavorText_DESC: “I didn’t come here to be robot food.” -Gabriel Soma
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S37P02_GameplayText_DESC:
While injured, whenever you finish healing another Survivor, you gain {Keyword.Endurance} for {Tunable.S37P02.EnduranceDuration}s.

While you have {Keyword.DeepWound}, you gain {Tunable.S37P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S37P03_FlavorText_DESC: “It’s amazing what people will throw away around here.” -Gabriel Soma
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S37P03_GameplayText_DESC:
While repairing and while your Toolbox is empty, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you earn {Tunable.S37P03.TokensPerGreat} Token.

When you have {Tunable.S37P03.MaxTokens} Tokens, spend them all:
  • Your Toolbox is recharged instantly.
  • You repair {Tunable.S37P03.RepairDebuff%}% slower for {Tunable.S37P03.RepairDebuffDuration}s.


You can rummage Chests {Tunable.S37P03.Rummages} time. The first time you rummage a Chest, it will contain an uncommon Toolbox.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S38P01_FlavorText_DESC: “Take the part. It’s a good movie, he says. What’s the worst that can happen?” -Nicolas Cage
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S38P01_GameplayText_DESC:
While healthy and running, use {Input.ActivatableButton1}:
  • You gain {Tunable.S38P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S38P01.HasteDuration}s.
  • You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S38P01.ExhaustionDuration}s.


Then, one happens at random:
  • You gain {Tunable.S38P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S38P01.HasteDuration}s.
  • You gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.S38P01.ExposedDuration}s.
  • You gain a random rare item with random add-ons.
  • You scream, but nothing happens.


The same effect cannot happen twice in a row.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S38P02_FlavorText_DESC: “This is not in the script!” -Nicolas Cage
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S38P02_GameplayText_DESC:
While you are within the Killer's Terror Radius, whenever you look at them:
  • Scream, then see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S38P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.
  • There is a {Tunable.S38P02.ChanceOfExtraScream%}% chance you will scream again. If you do, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S38P02.ExtraAuraRevealDuration}s more.


Cooldown: {Tunable.S38P02.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S38P03_FlavorText_DESC: “I think you’ll find this shooting location… captivating.” -Pauline Stamper
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S38P03_GameplayText_DESC:
While injured, crouched and idle, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to be downed silently.

While downed this way, once per trial:
  • You make no Grunts of Pain.
  • You leave no Pools of Blood.
  • You recover {Tunable.S38P03.RecoverySpeedIncrease%}% faster.
  • You can fully recover.


Whenever you recover this way:
  • You gain {Tunable.S38P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S38P03.HasteDuration}s.
  • You are healed instantly.


When all Generators are completed, you can use this ability once again.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S39P01_GameplayText_DESC:
While hiding in a Locker, you make no Grunts of Pain.

Whenever you exit a Locker, for {Tunable.S39P01.EffectDuration}s:
  • You see the Aura of the closest Generator.
  • You see the Auras of other Survivors.
  • You make no Grunts of Pain.
  • You leave no Pools of Blood.


Cooldown: {Tunable.S39P01.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S39P02_FlavorText_DESC: “How do we kill it, Ash?” -Ellen Ripley
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S39P02_GameplayText_DESC:
After repairing {Tunable.S39P02.RequiredProgress%}% of Generators, while next to a Dropped Pallet, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to trap it for {Tunable.S39P02.TrapDuration}s. All Survivors see that Pallet's Aura for that time.

When the Killer breaks that Pallet, the trap explodes and they gain {Tunable.S39P02.Hinder%}% {Keyword.Hindered} for {Tunable.S39P02.HinderDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S39P03_GameplayText_DESC:
While healthy and running, your footsteps are silent to the Killer.

Whenever you do a fast-action, cooldown: {Tunable.S39P03.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S40P01_FlavorText_DESC: “I squeezed the flashlight like my life depended on it, willing it to stop coming any closer.” -Departure
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S40P01_GameplayText_DESC:
While you are using a Flashlight, you gain {Tunable.S40P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.

Whenever you blind the Killer, they gain {Tunable.S40P01.Hindered%}% {Keyword.Hindered} for {Tunable.S40P01.HinderedDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.S40P01.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S40P02_FlavorText_DESC: "A shift in reality. Heavy with hidden meanings." -Return
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S40P02_GameplayText_DESC:
While next to a totem, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to bless it, creating a unique Boon totem that combines all your Boons.

Survivors within the Boon's range:
  • See the Auras of Chests.
  • See the Auras of Generators.


While you have a Boon Totem, you bless and cleanse {Tunable.S40P02.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S40P03_FlavorText_DESC: “The night had been one desperate situation after another.” -Departure
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S40P03_GameplayText_DESC:
While injured, basic Skill Checks:
  • Are {Tunable.S40P03.ExtraSkillCheckChance%}% more likely to appear.
  • Appear in random places.


Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, you lose {Tunable.S40P03.FailureMitigation%}% less progress.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S41P01_FlavorText_DESC: "I call upon the spirits of the night, to aid us in our desperate flight!" -Sable
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S41P01_GameplayText_DESC:
While in the Basement next to the circle, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to invoke. While invoking, other Survivors see your Aura and can join your Invocation.

When the Invocation is completed:
  • All Generators gain {Tunable.S41P01.GeneratorChargeReduction} permanent charges.
  • You become injured.
  • You gain {Keyword.Broken}.


Each Invocation can only be completed once per trial.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S41P02_FlavorText_DESC: "I’m getting out of here, if it’s the last thing I do.” -Sable
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S41P02_GameplayText_DESC:
While in the Basement:
  • You can heal yourself, but {Tunable.S41P02.SelfHealSpeed%}% slower.
  • Whenever you finish healing, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S41P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S41P03_FlavorText_DESC: “I haven’t let anyone get in my way before. You think I’m gonna start now?” -Sable
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S41P03_GameplayText_DESC:
While in the Basement, you can unhook yourself.

Whenever you are unhooked, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S41P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S42P01_GameplayText_DESC: After repairing {Tunable.S42P01.RequiredProgress%}% of Generators, while next to a Chest, Exit Gate Switch, Generator, or Totem, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to create a static illusion for {Tunable.S42P01.HuskDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S42P02_FlavorText_DESC: "Listen closely! I'm about to save your life!" -Aestri
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S42P02_GameplayText_DESC:
While idle, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to perform, empowering all Survivors within {Tunable.S42P02.PerformanceDistance}m for up to {Tunable.S42P02.PerformanceDuration}s. While you are performing, other Survivors will see your Aura. Roll a d20:
  • 1 | You scream, but nothing happens.
  • 2-10 | Basic Skill Checks give +{Tunable.S42P02.LowRollBonus%}% progress.
  • 11-19 | Basic Skill Checks give +{Tunable.S42P02.MidRollBonus%}% progress.
  • 20 | Basic Skill Checks give +{Tunable.S42P02.HighRollBonus%}% progress.


If you complete the performance, this effect ends after {Tunable.S42P02.EffectDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.S42P02.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S42P03_FlavorText_DESC: "Breathe in. Breathe out. Now open your eyes." -Baermar
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S42P03_GameplayText_DESC:
After being idle for {Tunable.S42P03.RequiredActivationTime}s, within {Tunable.S42P03.RevealDistance}m, until you start moving:
  • You see the Killer's Aura.
  • You see the Auras of Chests.
  • You see the Auras of Generators.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S43P01_FlavorText_DESC: "Just need to push myself a bit further." -Lara Croft
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S43P01_GameplayText_DESC:
While healthy, you fast-vault {Tunable.S43P01.VaultSpeedIncrease%}% faster.

Whenever you fast-vault, cooldown: {Tunable.S43P01.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S43P02_FlavorText_DESC: "Got to keep quiet. That thing is still out there." -Lara Croft
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S43P02_GameplayText_DESC: When you have blessed or cleansed a Totem and unlocked a Chest, whenever you would scream, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S43P02.AuraRevealDuration}s instead.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S43P03_FlavorText_DESC: "Well, then. Doesn't this feel familiar?" -Lara Croft
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S43P03_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you rummage or unlock a Chest, you earn {Tunable.S43P03.TokensPerChest} Token, up to {Tunable.S43P03.MaxTokens}.

While repairing a Generator, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent, the Generator gains {Tunable.S43P03.GenChargesRemoved%}% permanent progress.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S44P01_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever a Generator is completed, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S44P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.

Whenever you see the Killer's Aura for a duration, it is {Tunable.S44P01.AuraRevealBonusDuration}s longer.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S44P02_FlavorText_DESC: "You will not take me this day!" -Trevor
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S44P02_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you Pallet-stun the Killer:
  • Your item rarity is upgraded to the next tier, if possible.
  • If the item was upgraded, it recharges {Tunable.S44P02.ItemRecharge%}% Charges.


Cooldown: {Tunable.S44P02.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S44P03_FlavorText_DESC: "Never lose hope for a brighter tomorrow." -Trevor
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S44P03_GameplayText_DESC:
After you rummage or unlock {Tunable.S44P03.ChestSearchRequired} Chest, while not {Keyword.Broken}, when you become injured, gain {Keyword.Broken}.

After {Tunable.S44P03.TimeToHeal}s, if you are not downed, you are instantly healed.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S45P01_FlavorText_DESC: "Remember your training. They taught you all about the crows." -Taurie Cain
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S45P01_GameplayText_DESC:
While in the Basement next to the circle, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to invoke. While invoking, other Survivors see your Aura and can join your Invocation.

When the Invocation is completed:
  • Whenever the Killer scares a Crow while a Survivor is in their Terror Radius, all Survivors see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S45P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.
  • You become injured.
  • You gain {Keyword.Broken}.


Each Invocation can only be completed once per trial.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S45P02_FlavorText_DESC: "I'll be fine! Don't stick your neck out for me." -Taurie Cain
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S45P02_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you finish healing another Survivor, while being healed by another Survivor, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to gain {Keyword.Broken}.

After {Tunable.S45P02.TimeOfHeal}s, if you are not downed, you are instantly healed.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S45P03_FlavorText_DESC: "It's not your time yet. Now go on!" -Taurie Cain
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S45P03_GameplayText_DESC:
Once per trial, while you do not have {Tunable.S45P03.MaxHooksToDeactivate} Hook States and are next to a hooked Survivor, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to unhook them:
  • They lose 1 Hook State.
  • You gain 1 Hook State.
  • You scream.
  • You gain {Keyword.Exposed} for {Tunable.S45P03.ExposedDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S46P01_FlavorText_DESC: "Look at me. My name's Orela, and I'm gonna make sure you're all right." -Orela Rose
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S46P01_GameplayText_DESC:
While healing another Survivor:
  • For each Hook State they have, you heal {Tunable.S46P01.HealSpeedBonus%}% faster.
  • Whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, you gain {Tunable.S46P01.GreatSkillCheckBonus%}% more progress.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S46P02_FlavorText_DESC: "Don't worry about me. I've got a knack for bouncing back." -Orela Rose
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S46P02_GameplayText_DESC: While healthy, whenever you take a protection hit, other Survivors within {Tunable.S46P02.MaxDistance}m gain {Tunable.S46P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S46P02.HasteDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S46P03_FlavorText_DESC: "All right. You got this. 3... 2... 1... go!" -Orela Rose
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S46P03_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you fast-exit a Locker, you gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S46P03.ExhaustionDuration}s.

Whenever you gain {Keyword.Exhausted}, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S46P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S47P01_FlavorText_DESC: “Without the fences, this place is worthless.” -Rick Grimes
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S47P01_GameplayText_DESC:
After you rummage or unlock {Tunable.S47P01.ChestsRequired} Chest, while next to a Broken Pallet, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} for {Tunable.S47P01.InteractionDuration}s to create a Fragile Pallet.

Within {Tunable.S47P01.BrokenPalletsRevealDistance}m, you see the Auras of Broken Pallets.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S47P02_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you unhook a Survivor, while crouched and idle, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to have injured and downed Survivors within {Tunable.S47P02.EffectDistance}m:
  • Make no Grunts of Pain for {Tunable.S47P02.EffectDuration}s.
  • Leave no Pools of Blood for {Tunable.S47P02.EffectDuration}s.
  • Leave no Scratch Marks for {Tunable.S47P02.EffectDuration}s.


You scream, then the Killer sees your Aura for {Tunable.S47P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S47P03_FlavorText_DESC: “They're fucking with the wrong people.” -Rick Grimes
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S47P03_GameplayText_DESC:
While injured, whenever another Survivor within {Tunable.S47P03.RequiredDistance}m of you blinds or Pallet-stuns the Killer, for {Tunable.S47P03.Duration}s:
  • You make no Grunts of Pain.
  • You leave no Pools of Blood.
  • You leave no Scratch Marks.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S48P01_FlavorText_DESC: "It's enough to keep going. Keep trying. Keep fighting. Keep dreaming." -Michonne Grimes
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S48P01_GameplayText_DESC:
After you finish healing {Tunable.S48P01.RequiredHealthStates} other Survivor, while downed with at least {Tunable.S48P01.RecoverProgressNeeded%}% recovery, use {Input.ActivatableButton1} to recover instantly.

You gain {Keyword.Broken}, then, after {Tunable.S48P01.EffectDuration}s, you are downed instantly.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S48P02_FlavorText_DESC: "Some bullies, you can live with. Others, you gotta fight." -Michonne Grimes
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S48P02_GameplayText_DESC: After hiding for {Tunable.S48P02.ActivationTime}s within the Killer's Terror Radius, when you fast-vault, once per trial, stun the Killer for {Tunable.S48P02.StunDuration}s if they are within {Tunable.S48P02.StunRange}m.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S48P03_FlavorText_DESC: "Facing evil brings good people together." -Michonne Grimes
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S48P03_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you blind or Pallet-stun the Killer, for {Tunable.S48P03.EffectDuration}s, other injured Survivors within {Tunable.S48P03.EffectDistance}m:
  • Gain {Keyword.Endurance}.
  • See the Killer's Aura.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S49P01_FlavorText_DESC: “Remind me to teach you how to patch your own pedals, Krit.” -Vee Boonyasak
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S49P01_GameplayText_DESC:
While injured, not {Keyword.Broken} and repairing a Generator:
  • Whenever you hit a basic great Skill Check, you earn {Tunable.S49P01.TokenPerSkillCheck} Token.
  • Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, you lose {Tunable.S49P01.TokensLostOnSkillCheckFail} token.


When you have {Tunable.S49P01.MaxTokens} Tokens, spend all Tokens to heal {Tunable.S49P01.HealingSpeedIncrease%}% faster until you stop healing.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S49P02_FlavorText_DESC: “We are loud! We are heavy! WE ARE AXEKICK!” -Vee Boonyasak
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S49P02_GameplayText_DESC:
While idle, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to perform, empowering all Survivors within {Tunable.S49P02.PerformanceDistance}m for up to {Tunable.S49P02.PerformanceDuration}s. While you are performing, other Survivors will see your Aura. You get special Skill Checks during that time: while healing or repairing, basic Skill Checks are {Tunable.S49P02.SkillCheckIncrease%}% more likely to appear.

If you complete the performance, the effect ends after {Tunable.S49P02.EffectDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.S49P02.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S49P03_FlavorText_DESC: “Let’s take it to the bridge!” -Vee Boonyasak
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S49P03_GameplayText_DESC:
While you have {Keyword.Exhausted}, your Scratch Marks disappear {Tunable.S49P03.ScratchmarksTimeReduction%}% faster.

You lose {Keyword.Exhausted} {Tunable.S49P03.CooldownReduction%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S50P01_GameplayText_DESC:
After repairing {Tunable.S50P01.RequiredGeneratorProgress%}% of Generators, while next to a Window, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} to trap it for {Tunable.S50P01.TrapDuration}s. All Survivors see that Window's Aura for that time.

When the Killer vaults that Window, the trap explodes and they gain {Tunable.S50P01.TrapHinder%}% {Keyword.Hindered} for {Tunable.S50P01.HinderDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S50P02_FlavorText_DESC: “Oh my god, oh my god, oh my god, oh my god.” -Dustin Henderson
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S50P02_GameplayText_DESC:
When the trial starts, you earn {Tunable.S50P02.StartingTokens} Tokens.

While hiding in a Locker and holding a non-event Toolbox, use {Input.ActivatableButton2} and spend 1 Token to transform your Toolbox and add-ons into a Med-Kit of the same rarity with {Tunable.S50P02.RecoveredCharges%}% Charges and random add-ons of the same rarity.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S50P03_FlavorText_DESC: “How many times do I have to be right on the money before you guys just trust me?” -Dustin Henderson
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S50P03_GameplayText_DESC:
For each other Survivor repairing a Generator with you, good basic Skill Check zones are {Tunable.S50P03.SuccessZoneIncreasePerSurvivor%}% bigger.

While repairing with at least 1 other Survivor, you repair {Tunable.S50P03.RepairBonus%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S51P01_GameplayText_DESC:
After crouching for {Tunable.S51P01.CrouchActivationTime}s:
  • You see Auras in an expanding radius up to {Tunable.S51P01.MaxDistance}m.
  • You gain {Keyword.Elusive}.
  • You gain {Keyword.Oblivious}.


When you stop crouching, or after {Tunable.S51P01.MaxActiveListeningUptime}s, cooldown: {Tunable.S51P01.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S51P02_FlavorText_DESC: “It is not me. It is you. You are the monster.” -Eleven
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S51P02_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever the Killer sees your Aura, you earn {Tunable.S51P02.TokensPerReveal} Token. Cooldown: {Tunable.S51P02.CooldownBetweenTokens}s.

When you have {Tunable.S51P02.MaxTokens} Tokens, spend them all. Then, all Survivors see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S51P02.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S51P03_GameplayText_DESC:
For each other Survivor repairing a Generator with you, the range of Generator repair noises is {Tunable.S51P03.NoiseReductionPerSurvivor%}% smaller.

While repairing with at least 1 other Survivor, you repair {Tunable.S51P03.RepairBonus%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S52P01_FlavorText_DESC: “I’m sorry… I didn’t realize I was working so late.” -Kwon Tae-young
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S52P01_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever a Generator is completed, earn {Tunable.S52P01.TokensPerGenerator} Token, up to {Tunable.S52P01.MaxTokens}.

For each Token:
  • You bless and cleanse {Tunable.S52P01.ActionSpeedBuff%}% faster.
  • You heal {Tunable.S52P01.ActionSpeedBuff%}% faster.
  • You unhook Survivors {Tunable.S52P01.ActionSpeedBuff%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S52P02_FlavorText_DESC: “I understand computers… systems. Problems. But this… I wonder if I’ll ever understand.” -Kwon Tae-young
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S52P02_GameplayText_DESC:
While healing another Survivor, you both gain {Keyword.Elusive}.

Whenever you finish healing the Obsession, you both gain {Keyword.Elusive} for {Tunable.S52P02.EffectDuration}s.

When the trial starts, you are less likely to be the Obsession.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S52P03_FlavorText_DESC: “Every problem has a solution. It’s only a question of complexity.” -Kwon Tae-young
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_S52P03_GameplayText_DESC:
While you are in the Killer's Terror Radius or chased by the Killer:
  • You see the Auras of the {Tunable.S52P03.PalletWindowAuraCount} closest Pallets and Windows.
  • After you drop a Pallet, you start moving {Tunable.S52P03.ActionSpeedBuff%}% earlier.
  • Whenever you drop a Pallet, cooldown: {Tunable.S52P03.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Saboteur_GameplayText_DESC:
Within {Tunable.S04P03.RevealHookDistance}m of where another Survivor was picked-up by the Killer and is being carried, you see the Auras of Hooks and Scourge Hooks.

You can sabotage Hooks. Cooldown: {Tunable.S04P03.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_SaveTheBestForLast_FlavorText_DESC: "Death has come to your little town, sheriff." -Dr. Sam Loomis
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_SaveTheBestForLast_GameplayText_DES:
Whenever you damage a Survivor who is not the Obsession with a basic-attack, you earn {Tunable.K06P01.TokensGainedOnHit} Token, up to {Tunable.K06P01.MaxTokens}.

For each Token, your basic-attack cooldown are {Tunable.K06P01.AttackReductionPerToken%}% shorter.

Whenever the Obsession takes damage, lose {Tunable.K06P01.TokensLostOnHit} Tokens.

While the Obsession is dead, you cannot earn Tokens.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_SecondWind_GameplayText_DESC:
After you heal {Tunable.S18P03.RequiredHealthState} Survivor, while not {Keyword.Broken}, when you are unhooked, you gain {Keyword.Broken}.

After {Tunable.S18P03.DurationOfHeal}s, if you are not downed, you are instantly healed.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_SelfCare_GameplayText_DESC: You can heal yourself, but {Tunable.S03P03.SelfHealSpeed%}% slower.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Shadowborn_FlavorText_DESC: "Shining in the darkest dark, his eyes pierce the night and sting your soul."
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Shadowborn_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you are blinded, gain {Tunable.K02P03.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.K02P03.Duration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_SlipperyMeat_GameplayText_DESC: You can attempt to unhook yourself up to {Tunable.SG_Slippery_Meat.ExtraAttempts} times and have {Tunable.SG_Slippery_Meat.HookEscapeChance%}% more chance to succeed.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_SloppyButcher_FlavorText_DESC: "It's in its sadistic nature. There is no swift kill as it delights in the obscene spectacle of our agonizing suffering."
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_SloppyButcher_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you damage a Survivor with a basic-attack:
  • They gain {Keyword.Hemorrhage} for {Tunable.KG_Sloppy_Butcher.Duration}s.
  • They gain {Keyword.Mangled} for {Tunable.KG_Sloppy_Butcher.Duration}s.


Survivors with {Keyword.Hemorrhage} lose healing progress {Tunable.KG_Sloppy_Butcher.HemmorhageBoost%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_SmallGame_GameplayText_DESC:
Within {Tunable.SG_Small_Game.PerkEffectDistance}m of you, whenever you look at a Totem in a {Tunable.SG_Small_Game.DetectionConeAngle} degree cone, you hear a sound cue. Cooldown: {Tunable.SG_Small_Game.Cooldown}s.

Whenever a Survivor cleanses a Totem, you earn {Tunable.SG_Small_Game.TokensPerTotem} Token, up to {Tunable.SG_Small_Game.MaxTokens}.

For each Token, the cone is {Tunable.SG_Small_Game.ConeAngleReduction} degrees smaller.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_SoleSurvivor_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever a Survivor dies, you earn {Tunable.S06P01.TokensPerDeadSurvivor} Token.

For each Token, within {Tunable.S06P01.StealthPerMissingSurvivorDistance}m, the Killer cannot see your Aura.

When all other Survivors are dead:
  • You repair {Tunable.S06P01.RepairSpeedBonus%}% faster.
  • You open Exit Gates and the Hatch {Tunable.S06P01.EscapeActionSpeeds%}% faster.


When the trial starts, you are more likely to be the Obsession.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Solidarity_FlavorText_DESC: “Showing up when things get rough and supporting those in need; that’s how you become stronger, that’s how you grow.” -Jane Romero
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Solidarity_GameplayText_DESC: While injured and healing another Survivor without a Med-Kit, you also gain healing progress at {Tunable.S16P01.HealRatio}% speed.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_SoulGuard_GameplayText_DESC:
While hexed, you can fully recover.

Whenever you fully recover, you gain {Keyword.Endurance} for {Tunable.S22P01.EnduranceDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.S22P01.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_SpiesFromTheShadows_FlavorText_DESC: "In the shadows they torment, scarring our minds with each scream."
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_SpiesFromTheShadows_GameplayText_DE: Whenever a Survivor scares a Crow within {Tunable.KG_Spies_From_The_Shadows.NotificationRange}m of you, you are alerted. Cooldown: {Tunable.KG_Spies_From_The_Shadows.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_SpineChill_GameplayText_DESC:
Within {Tunable.SG_Spine_Chill.Range}m, whenever the Killer looks at you, you hear a sound cue.

Within {Tunable.SG_Spine_Chill.Range}m, while the Killer is looking at you:
  • You bless and cleanse Totems {Tunable.SG_Spine_Chill.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
  • You heal {Tunable.SG_Spine_Chill.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
  • You open Exit Gates {Tunable.SG_Spine_Chill.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
  • You repair Generators {Tunable.SG_Spine_Chill.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
  • You sabotage Hooks {Tunable.SG_Spine_Chill.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
  • You unhook Survivors {Tunable.SG_Spine_Chill.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
  • You unlock Chests {Tunable.SG_Spine_Chill.ActionSpeed%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_SpiritFury_GameplayText_DESC: After you break {Tunable.K13P01.PalletsRequired} Pallets, when you are Pallet-stunned, the Pallet is destroyed.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_SprintBurst_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you start running:
  • You gain {Tunable.S02P02.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste} for {Tunable.S02P02.HasteDuration}s.
  • You gain {Keyword.Exhausted} for {Tunable.S02P02.ExhaustionDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_StakeOut_FlavorText_DESC: "I had you, I had you on your knees. You're runnin' scared because we had you. We're gonna close this case!" -Detective David Tapp
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_StakeOut_GameplayText_DESC:
After hiding for {Tunable.S12P03.TokenChargeTime}s within the Killer's Terror Radius, you earn {Tunable.S12P03.TokensGained} Token, up to {Tunable.S12P03.MaxTokens}.

Whenever you hit a good basic Skill Check, spend {Tunable.S12P03.TokensSpent} Token:
  • The good Skill Check becomes a great Skill Check.
  • You gain {Tunable.S12P03.BonusProgress%}% more progress.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Streetwise_FlavorText_DESC: "You're doing it wrong! Let me show you how it's done." - Nea
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Streetwise_GameplayText_DESC:
The first time you deplete an item's Charges, you see the Killer's Aura for {Tunable.S05P03.AuraRevealDuration}s.

Whenever you loot an item from a Chest, it has {Tunable.S05P03.BonusMaxChargePercentages%}% more Charges.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Stridor_FlavorText_DESC: “If you don’t stop and catch your breath… she will.”
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Stridor_GameplayText_DESC: Survivors' breathing noises are {Tunable.K04P01.HealthySoundIncrease%}% louder and their Grunts of Pain are {Tunable.K04P01.InjuredSoundIncrease%}% louder.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Surge_FlavorText_DESC: “The creature appears to have some unknown influence over electricity and nearby electronics.” -Hawkins National Laboratory
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Surge_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you down a Survivor with a basic-attack, Generators within {Tunable.K17P01.AffectedDistance}m:
  • Explode, lose {Tunable.K17P01.Regression%}% progress and start regressing.
  • Survivor repairing them scream.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Surveillance_GameplayText_DESC:
You see the Auras of regressing Generators.

Whenever a Generator stops regressing, you see its Aura for {Tunable.K11P02.RevealTime}s.

Generator repair noises can be heard from {Tunable.K11P02.NoiseRangeIncreaseDistance}m farther away.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Technician_GameplayText_DESC:
While repairing a Generator:
  • The range of Generator repair noises is {Tunable.S09P01.RepairNoiseDistanceReduction}m shorter.
  • Whenever you miss a basic Skill Check, the Generator does not explode, but loses {Tunable.S09P01.ExtraProgressLost%}% more progress.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Tenacity_FlavorText_DESC: "What the hell is this? I'm taking this bastard down!" -Detective David Tapp
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Tenacity_GameplayText_DESC:
While downed:
  • You gain {Tunable.S12P01.Haste%}% {Keyword.Haste}.
  • You can crawl and recover at the same time.
  • Your Grunts of Pain are {Tunable.S12P01.DyingVoiceLevelReduction%}% quieter.
  • The Killer cannot see your Aura.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_TerritorialImperative_GameplayText_: Whenever a Survivor enters the Basement while you are {Tunable.K08P02.MinimumDistance}m away from it, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K08P02.RevealTime}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K08P02.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Thanatophobia_FlavorText_DESC: "She plays with us and revels in our pain."
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Thanatophobia_GameplayText_DESC:
For each injured, downed, or hooked Survivor, all Survivors:
  • Cleanse totems {Tunable.K04P02.ActionSpeedPenaltyPerSurvivor%}% slower.
  • Repair {Tunable.K04P02.ActionSpeedPenaltyPerSurvivor%}% slower.
  • Sabotage Hooks {Tunable.K04P02.ActionSpeedPenaltyPerSurvivor%}% slower.


While 4 Survivors are either injured, downed or hooked, all above actions are additionally {Tunable.K04P02.ActionSpeedPenaltyBonus%}% slower.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_TheMettleOfMan_FlavorText_DESC: "Evil has a bullseye on my back the size of Tiger Stadium." -Ash Williams
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_TheMettleOfMan_GameplayText_DESC:
After taking {Tunable.S17P03.TokensNeeded} protection hits, while injured and until you go down, the next time you would be downed by the Killer, take no damage instead.

When you become healthy, while you are at least {Tunable.S17P03.AuraRevealDistance}m from the Killer, they see your Aura.

When the trial starts, you are more likely to be the Obsession.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_ThisIsNotHappening_GameplayText_DES: While injured, great basic Skill Check zones are {Tunable.SG_This_Is_Not_Happening.GreatZoneSizeBonus%}% bigger.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_ThrillingTremors_FlavorText_DESC: "The night assists me and it’s endless here." -The Ghost Face
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_ThrillingTremors_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you pick-up a Survivor, all Generators not being repaired are blocked for {Tunable.K16P02.Duration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.K16P02.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Tinkerer_FlavorText_DESC: "The Hillbilly makes impressive tools out of scraps. Tools aimed at maiming us in creative ways..." -Notebook
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Tinkerer_GameplayText_DESC:
The first time each Generator has {Tunable.K03P03.TriggerThreshold%}% progress:
  • You gain {Keyword.Undetectable} for {Tunable.K03P03.UndetectableDuration}s.
  • You are alerted.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_TrailofTorment_GameplayText_DESC:
Whenever you damage a Generator, until it stops regressing:
  • You gain {Keyword.undetectable}.
  • Survivors see that Generator's Aura.


Cooldown: {Tunable.K20P02.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_UnnervingPresence_GameplayText_DESC:
Survivors within your Terror Radius get {Tunable.K01P01.SkillcheckOddsIncrease%}% more basic Skill Checks.

The good zone of basic Skill Checks is {Tunable.K01P01.SuccessZoneSizePenalty%}% smaller.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Unrelenting_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you miss a basic-attack, your cooldown is {Tunable.KG_Unrelenting.AttackMissCooldownReduction%}% shorter.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_UpTheAnte_FlavorText_DESC: “What can I say? I’m just a very lucky guy… I’m sure some of it will rub off on you.” -Ace
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_UpTheAnte_GameplayText_DESC:
For each other Survivor alive, all Survivors are {Tunable.S07P02.LuckIncrease%}% luckier.

All Survivors can attempt to unhook themselves.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_UrbanEvasion_FlavorText_DESC: "The paint is still fresh but I'm long gone." -Nea
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Vigil_FlavorText_DESC: "I'm gonna be here when you wake up. You're gonna make it." -Quentin Smith
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Vigil_GameplayText_DESC:
All Survivors within {Tunable.S11P03.EffectRange}m of you:
  • Lose {Keyword.Blindness} {Tunable.S11P03.RecoveryIncrease%}% faster.
  • Lose {Keyword.Broken} {Tunable.S11P03.RecoveryIncrease%}% faster.
  • Lose {Keyword.Exhausted} {Tunable.S11P03.RecoveryIncrease%}% faster.
  • Lose {Keyword.Exposed} {Tunable.S11P03.RecoveryIncrease%}% faster.
  • Lose {Keyword.Hemorrhage} {Tunable.S11P03.RecoveryIncrease%}% faster.
  • Lose {Keyword.Hindered} {Tunable.S11P03.RecoveryIncrease%}% faster.
  • Lose {Keyword.Mangled} {Tunable.S11P03.RecoveryIncrease%}% faster.
  • Lose {Keyword.Oblivious} {Tunable.S11P03.RecoveryIncrease%}% faster.


After they leave your range, this ends after {Tunable.S11P03.LingerDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Visionary_GameplayText_DESC:
Within {Tunable.S23P01.AuraRevealDistance}m of you, you see the Auras of Generators.

Whenever a Generator is completed, cooldown: {Tunable.S23P01.Cooldown}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_WakeUp_GameplayText_DESC:
When all Generators are completed:
  • You see the Auras of Exit Gate Switches.
  • While opening an Exit Gate, other Survivors see your Aura.
  • For each Survivor alive, you open Exit Gates {Tunable.S11P01.GateOpenSpeed%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_WellMakeIt_FlavorText_DESC: "I'm confident we can all escape in one piece if we help each other."
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_WellMakeIt_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you unhook a Survivor, for {Tunable.SG_Well_Make_It.Duration}s, you heal other Survivors {Tunable.SG_Well_Make_It.HealingSpeedIncrease%}% faster.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_WereGonnaLiveForever_FlavorText_DES: “Come on then, let’s ‘ave it! I don’t give a shit pal.” -David King
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_WereGonnaLiveForever_GameplayText_D:
You heal downed Survivors {Tunable.S10P01.HealSpeedIncrease%}% faster.

Whenever you finish healing a downed Survivor, they gain {Keyword.Endurance} for {Tunable.S10P01.EnduranceDuration}s. Cooldown: {Tunable.S10P01.EnduranceCooldownDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Whispers_FlavorText_DESC: "It's unclear as to the motivations of The Fog, but it is undeniable that it often takes the beast's side." -Notebook
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_Whispers_GameplayText_DESC: While within {Tunable.KG_Whispers.RangeToSurvivors}m of a Survivor, you randomly hear whispers.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_WindowsOfOpportunity_FlavorText_DES: “Carve your name/Value faith an’ family, don’t complain/Open your windows of opportunity.” -Kate Denson's Windows of Opportunity
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_WindowsOfOpportunity_GameplayText_D:
Within {Tunable.S13P02.VaultablesRevealDistance}m of you:
  • You see the Auras of Pallets.
  • You see the Auras of Breakable Walls.
  • You see the Auras of Windows.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_ZanshinTactics_FlavorText_DESC: “Within your enemy’s strength is weakness.” -Renjiro’s Doctrine 12:5
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_ZanshinTactics_GameplayText_DESC:
Within {Tunable.K18P01.VaultablesRevealDistance}m, you see the Auras of Pallets and windows.

Whenever a Survivor drops a Pallet, you see their Aura for {Tunable.K18P01.AuraRevealDuration}s.
PerkDescriptionsNamespace.PERK_popgoestheweasel_GameplayText_DESC: Whenever you hook a Survivor, for the next {Tunable.K12P03.ActiveDuration}s, when you damage a Generator, it explodes and loses {Tunable.K12P03.ExtraGeneratorDamage%}% more progress.

ST_CM_Torso031_01.CUST_CM_Torso031_01_DESC: Ten years in The Fog, and we’ve got the sweater to prove it.

ST_DB_CustomizationItem_K41_outfit_009.CUST_K41_Body009_DESC: When she stepped through the overgrowth, the pungent smell of carrion and putrid flora filled her nose, awakening her monstrous appetite.
ST_DB_CustomizationItem_K41_outfit_009.CUST_K41_Head009_DESC: She wandered beneath a suffocating canopy of dying trees, numb to the infestation that coursed through her veins.
ST_DB_CustomizationItem_K41_outfit_009.CUST_K41_W009_DESC: She conducted a ballad for the worms, a song of fungal blood and earth-rotted flesh.

ST_DB_CustomizationItem_S31_outfit_024.CUST_S31_Head024_DESC: She crept beneath the ramshackle gate, passing derelict ruins choked by overgrowth, until something caught her eye.
ST_DB_CustomizationItem_S31_outfit_024.CUST_S31_Legs024_DESC: As reality faded, she realized they weren’t flowers at all. They were hands, protruding from the soil, fingers twisted in a desperate, pleading grasp.
ST_DB_CustomizationItem_S31_outfit_024.CUST_S31_Torso024_DESC: Amidst the decay stood a garden of flowers, surging colour into the lifeless world. She approached, stepping into The Overlap's’ cold embrace.

ST_DB_NarrativeCollection_DBDNarrativeCo.NARRATIVECOLLECTION_Collectible_001_DESC: “My years of faithful service came to fruition: I received an invitation to the most exclusive event in the world, where those who shape the future break bread.”
ST_DB_NarrativeCollection_DBDNarrativeCo.NARRATIVECOLLECTION_Collectible_001_Inte:
Dearest [REDACTED]
 
Your works in service of The Black Vale these past years have proven invaluable to our cause.

For your efforts, you are cordially invited to join us at this year's banquet. Remember your vows. A broken silence will be punished.

14, 3, 12, 29, 1; 51.90, -3.18
ST_DB_NarrativeCollection_DBDNarrativeCo.NARRATIVECOLLECTION_Collectible_002_001_:
“Her testimony, as writ by her hallowed hand, shall remain protected from mortal eyes until we are blessed by her return.” 

(Marika's Declaration, 12:1)
ST_DB_NarrativeCollection_DBDNarrativeCo.NARRATIVECOLLECTION_Collectible_002_002_:
"Thus did the righteous stand before the wicked undaunted, for she had nothing to fear, nor a heart encumbered by doubt.” 

(Larichus, 12:5)
Judgment's Bane by Bernard of New Stellanatis
ST_DB_NarrativeCollection_DBDNarrativeCo.NARRATIVECOLLECTION_Collectible_002_003_:
Your Holiness,

I deliver to you my masterpiece. I felt the savior herself guiding my hand with each brushstroke. May you continue to triumph over our enemies, as she triumphed over Judgment.

Eternally yours,

Bernard of New Stellanatis
ST_DB_NarrativeCollection_DBDNarrativeCo.NARRATIVECOLLECTION_Collectible_002_004_:
"And whilst she spoke of its greater purpose, as writ within the cosmic tapestry, her loyal followers were all the same despaired to set eyes upon its cursed shape."

(Larichus, 9:3)
ST_DB_NarrativeCollection_DBDNarrativeCo.NARRATIVECOLLECTION_Collectible_002_005_:
"For the sin of heresy is met with Judgment’s righteous fury, as had learned the Council’s most esteemed Grand Inquisitor, whose gilded robes burned swiftly as the pauper’s rags."

(Truths Revealed, ch. 1)
ST_DB_NarrativeCollection_DBDNarrativeCo.NARRATIVECOLLECTION_Collectible_002_006_:
"Heed the legacy of the Council, among the first to suffer Judgment’s wrath. For it was they, in their limitless tyranny, that wrought this cycle upon us. How many of their withheld secrets lie buried beneath the ash?"

(Truths Revealed, ch. 1)
ST_DB_NarrativeCollection_DBDNarrativeCo.NARRATIVECOLLECTION_Collectible_002_007_:
"With unburdened spirit the devoted plunged their palms unto the spike, awaiting blissful release, awash in the glow of Judgment’s eternal light. Oh, exalted one. Sate our broken lips with your mercy!" 

(I Barbarians, ch. 6)
ST_DB_NarrativeCollection_DBDNarrativeCo.NARRATIVECOLLECTION_Collectible_002_DESC: “The superintendent asked me to redact almost everything from the report. But I’ll never be able to unsee what I saw that day.”
ST_DB_NarrativeCollection_DBDNarrativeCo.NARRATIVECOLLECTION_Collectible_003_DESC: “You know, my great-grandfather was there... Really! I had no idea he was involved until I was invited myself.”
ST_DB_NarrativeCollection_DBDNarrativeCo.NARRATIVECOLLECTION_Collectible_004_DESC: “Every year they ask for the same plate at the center of their banquet. And I prepare it the same every year. Whatever happened after that had NOTHING to do with me.”
ST_DB_NarrativeCollection_DBDNarrativeCo.NARRATIVECOLLECTION_Collectible_005_DESC: “They grow too interested in power mongering. They have lost sight of our greater goal. A goal of service. The plan was to remind them.”
ST_DB_NarrativeCollection_DBDNarrativeCo.NARRATIVECOLLECTION_Collectible_006_DESC: “I feel like I'm turning inside out. It is an awful, glorious feeling. That which I seek is inside me... I am just expelling everything that isn't Him.”
ST_DB_NarrativeCollection_DBDNarrativeCo.NARRATIVECOLLECTION_Collectible_007_DESC: “Get it out. It's poison get it out get it out give me the knife get it out GIVE ME THE KNIFE get it out get it out get—”
ST_DB_NarrativeCollection_DBDNarrativeCo.NARRATIVECOLLECTION_Collectible_008_DESC: “NFA. Not my circus. Not my monkeys. Forecast hazy, nasty, 50% chance of apocalypse.”
ST_DB_NarrativeCollection_DBDNarrativeCo.NARRATIVECOLLECTION_Collectible_009_DESC: “So beautiful... if only you could see what I see. It is so much bigger than I could have even imagined... and so much more violent.”
ST_DB_NarrativeCollection_DBDNarrativeCo.NARRATIVECOLLECTION_Collectible_010_DESC: “NFA. I've seen enough. This place is a wobbly tower, tilting, shaking, shivering. Don't want to be here when gravity kicks in.”

ST_DB_OutfitDB_S31_outfit_024.OUTFIT_S31_024_DESC:
Uncle Stefan set her sights on an abandoned medieval garden, rumored to have been tended by a notorious occultist.

Design inspired by Ace.

ST_DB_Outfit_K41_outfit_009.OUTFIT_K41_009_DESC: She arose from the earth after a night of feasting, severing the roots that had wormed their way into her skin.

ST_DB_S52_Outfit_008.CUST_S52_Head008_DESC: Work fought to infiltrate his thoughts, but he focused on the rhythm of the waves.
ST_DB_S52_Outfit_008.CUST_S52_Legs008_DESC: Eun-ji warned him that if he so much as glanced at his phone, he'd be walking home in his bathing suit.
ST_DB_S52_Outfit_008.CUST_S52_Torso008_DESC: He imagined his inbox filling with messages. There was swimming to be done, but it couldn’t hurt to check his email.
ST_DB_S52_Outfit_008.OUTFIT_S52_008_DESC: After countless hours coding in the dark, Tae-young had to admit that a day in the sun would do his body good.

ST_DF_Torso037_01.CUST_DF_Torso037_01_DESC: Ten years in The Fog, and we’ve got the sweater to prove it.

ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_01_DESC:
Good for digging up weeds and digging into human flesh.

Increases the duration of Killer Instinct after a Jump Scare by 2 seconds.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_02_DESC:
All that remained of the victim's wheelchair after the fatal blow.

Increases the range at which you can trigger Jump Scare by 4 meters.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_03_DESC:
You won't believe what—and who—this thing has been through.

Increases the time it takes for injured Impaled Survivors to extract the Spike from themselves by 20%.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_04_DESC:
It hung from her twitching foot as the knife plunged into her belly.

Increases the duration of Haste after a Jump Scare by 5 seconds.

Haste increases Killer movement speed.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_05_DESC:
An absolutely awful place to hide from a killer.

After grabbing a Hook Spike while in Omnipresent Evil mode, see the locations of Survivors within 10 meters of hooks.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_06_DESC:
He wasn't happy after his face was smashed into a tree.

Increases Jump Scare and Omnipresent Evil's detection range of Survivors by 4 meters.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_07_DESC:
No one could survive being submerged in this poison.

After a Jump Scare, Survivors within 10 meters of a hook or Scrap Pile gain Oblivious for 13 seconds.

Oblivious prevents Survivors from hearing and being affected by the Killer's Terror Radius.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_08_DESC:
A party instument that tore through a woman's eyeball and gouged her brain.

Breaking a Pallet or Breakable Wall with Jump Scare reveals the Auras of Survivors further than 28 meters for 6 seconds.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_09_DESC:
A cup of coffee that went unfinished.

Increases the distance Survivors are pushed by Spikes by 25%.

Gain 13% Haste for 3 seconds after injuring a Survivor with a Spike if they do not collide with the environment.

Haste increases Killer movement speed.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_10_DESC:
Nicely weighted, could be used to crush a rib cage.

After a Jump Scare, inflict all Survivors within Killer Instinct's detection range with Exhausted for 3 seconds.

Exhausted prevents Survivors from activating exhausting perks.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_11_DESC:
A weapon that dealt more than bad luck.

Impaled Survivors become Broken for 40 seconds after extracting the Spike.

Broken prevents Survivors from being healed.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_12_DESC:
It's either avant-garde artwork, or the horrified imprint of a woman whose face was slammed into it.

Injuring a healthy Survivor with a Spike inflicts the Mangled and Hemorrhage status effects for 70 seconds.

Mangled increases time required to heal by 25% and lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.

Hemorrhage regresses healing progress when not healing, and increases blood trails left by injured survivors. This lasts for a set duration or until fully healed.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_13_DESC:
A reliable way to hold a corpse's wrist in place.

Spikes that come within 1 meter of a Survivor reveal their Aura for 5 seconds.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_14_DESC:
What remains when a harpoon is shoved into one's eye.

Gain Undetectable for 13 seconds after grabbing a Hook Spike.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_15_DESC:
The spattering of blood told the story of a brutal massacre.

When a Hook Spike misses, all Survivors within 8 meters of the impact scream and reveal their Auras for 3 seconds.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_16_DESC:
The surge of electricity was overwhelming. It left the man's flesh charred and smelling of cooked meat.

While a Survivor is Impaled and for 5 seconds after they extract the Spike, the Exit Gates are blocked for them and any Survivors within 13 meters.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_17_DESC:
It seems to always be missing when you need it on-hand.

Impaled Survivors emit a 32 meter Terror Radius until the Spike is extracted.

Gain Undetectable from the time a Survivor is Impaled to 13 seconds after they extract the Spike.

Undetectable hides the Killer's aura, Terror Radius, and Red Stain.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_18_DESC:
The badge of an officer who discovered that some things aren't worth investigating.

While in Omnipresent Evil, passing within 2 meters of a generator will cause it to explode, losing 5% progress and begin regressing. If any survivors are repairing the generator, it doesn't explode, but they get a special Skill Check.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_19_DESC:
No amount of money can save you from him.

Gain 2 Tokens whenever a Generator is completed.

If you are not holding a Spike when vaulting a Window or breaking a Pallet or Breakable Wall, immediately spend a Token and gain a Spike.
ST_GP_AddOns.ADDON_K43_20_DESC:
The blades are chipped and cracked, as if having cut through something solid.

Passing through Windows while in Omnipresent Evil mode marks them for 13 seconds. When you perform a Jump Scare, all marked Windows become blocked for 13 seconds.

ST_UI_Currency.CURRENCY_AnniversaryEventCurrency_DESC:
BANQUET COINS are an EVENT currency used exclusively to unlock new BLACK BANQUET customization items in the Collection screen.

Banquet Coins can be acquired by completing BLACK BANQUET quests.
ST_UI_Currency.CURRENCY_HalloweenEventCurrency_DESC:
DARK TRINKETS are an EVENT currency used exclusively to unlock new HAUNTED BY DAYLIGHT customization items in the Collection screen.

Dark Trinkets may only be acquired by completing Haunted by Daylight quests.
ST_UI_Currency.CURRENCY_LunarNewYearCoins_DESC:
Golden Coins are a STORE currency, used exclusively to purchase MOONRISE event customization items.

Golden Coins may only be acquired during the Moonrise event.

  • Golden Coins will expire shortly after the event has ended.
ST_UI_Currency.CURRENCY_SpringEventCurrency_DESC:
BLOOD TRINKETS are an EVENT currency used exclusively to unlock new BLOOD MOON customization items in the Collection screen.

Blood Trinkets may only be acquired by completing Blood Moon Quests.
ST_UI_Currency.CURRENCY_WinterEventCurrency_DESC:
FROSTY TRINKETS are an EVENT currency used exclusively to unlock new BONE CHILL customization items in the Collection screen.

Frosty Trinkets may only be acquired from the Bone Chill event by completing quests.

ST_UI_Currency_Atlanta.CURRENCY_BloodPointsAtlanta_DESC:
BLOODPOINTS are your currency. They are used to purchase ITEMS, ADD-ONS and OFFERINGS in the BLOODMARKET.
Most In-game actions trigger scoring events that are converted into BloodPoints at the end of a match.

Certains add-ons, offerings, perks and events may modify the amount of BloodPoints you receive.

BloodPoints are capped at 1,000,000.
ST_UI_Currency_Atlanta.CURRENCY_HardCurrencyAtlanta_DESC:
AURIC CELLS are your STORE currency. They are used to unlock characters and customization items in the store. Auric Cells can only be acquired in the in-game store or earned as rewards in the Login Calendar and by completing Daily Rituals. Unlocking full outfits with Auric Cells will often grant a discount.

  • Auric Cells are not capped.
ST_UI_Currency_Atlanta.CURRENCY_ShardsAtlanta_DESC:
IRIDESCENT SHARDS are your PLAYER PROGRESSION currency. These may be used to unlock characters and customization items in the store. They are acquired by gaining experience points (XP), increasing your Player Level and completing Daily Rituals.

  • Iridescent Shards are not capped.

ST_UI_LightSensitivity.LIGHTSENSITIVITY_Content_MESSAGE:
A very small percentage of people may experience epileptic seizures or blackouts when exposed to certain kinds of flashing lights or light patterns. These persons, or even people who have no history of seizures or epilepsy, may experience epileptic symptoms or seizures while playing video games.

If you or any of your relatives has an epileptic condition or has had seizures of any kind, consult your physician before playing any video game.

IMMEDIATELY DISCONTINUE use and consult a physician if you or your child experience any of the following symptoms: dizziness, altered vision, eye or muscle twitching, involuntary movements, loss of awareness, disorientation, or convulsions. Parents should watch for or ask their children about the above symptoms.

You may reduce risk of photosensitive epileptic seizures by taking the following precautions: sit farther from the screen, use a smaller screen, play in a well-lit room, do not play when you are drowsy or fatigued.
